raw.description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We are hiring a Retention Specialist — a strategic, hands-on lifecycle marketer with a proven track record in email and SMS for DTC brands. You'll partner closely with Associate Directors of Retention and cross-functional teams to develop and deploy high-performing campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world — translating data into strategy and strategy into revenue.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance - while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

  • Lead the execution of email and SMS strategies for a portfolio of DTC/e-commerce clients, working alongside our Associate Directors of Retention to align on goals and priorities.

  • Own the end-to-end campaign deployment process - copywriting, briefing, testing, QA, deployment, and performance monitoring.

  • Contribute to monthly retention marketing calendars and proactively bring creative campaign concepts to clients and internal teams.

  • Lead portions of client calls - presenting content ideas and managing the revision and approval process with confidence.

  • Partner with the in-house design team to shape the creative direction of campaigns and flows, ensuring visual and copy are working together to drive results.

  • Build, audit, and optimize automation flows, pop-up logic, segmentation strategies, and app integrations.

  • Analyze campaign and flow performance and surface actionable recommendations that improve retention KPIs over time.

Who You Are:

We're looking for a Retention Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.

  • You have 3-5 years of experience in email and SMS marketing, lifecycle marketing, or CRM — ideally at a DTC-focused agency or in-house at an e-commerce brand.

  • You're a Klaviyo power user — flows, segmentation, A/B testing, deliverability, and reporting are all in your toolkit.

  • You're a strong copywriter who can adapt tone and voice across different brands and audiences.

  • You think strategically about the customer journey and know how to use retention levers to drive LTV and reduce churn.

  • You’re client-facing and comfortable - you can present a strategy and manage feedback without heavy direction.

  • You're highly organized, self-managed, and used to owning multiple accounts simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

  • You have excellent written and verbal English — you communicate with clarity and confidence to both clients and internal stakeholders.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • You have 3-5 years of experience in email/SMS marketing, growth marketing, or ecommerce CRM.

  • You have agency experience or have worked on multiple client accounts simultaneously.

  • You're a Klaviyo expert — and have the performance results to back it up.

  • You've contributed to client relationships and can present strategy and data to senior stakeholders.

  • You're proactive, creative, and hold yourself to a high standard without needing someone to push you.

  • You're passionate about DTC, ecommerce, and the evolving landscape of lifecycle marketing.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

GNC Engineer - Hybrid (TS/SCI Clearance)

Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions. 


Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact. 


Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment. 


Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!

Around here, we define the future.

We are a company of innovators, thinkers, creators, explorers, volunteers, and dreamers. But we all share one goal: to improve the world responsibly and safely.

Position Summary- Hybrid

THIS POSITION IS CONTINGENT UPON CONTRACT AWARD

We are seeking a GNC Engineer to support the design, development, testing, and real-time operation of advanced aerospace systems. This role bridges engineering development and flight/operational execution, requiring strong technical depth, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to translate complex system behavior into actionable decisions.

The ideal candidate brings experience across flight dynamics, control systems, software interaction, and operational environments.

This is a remote position with limited, business-need driven travel to onsite locations.

Key Responsibilities

  • GNC System Development & Integration
    • Support design, analysis, and verification of guidance, navigation, and control algorithms and architecture
    • Review and guide flight software design to improve system performance, robustness, and operability
    • Evaluate system behavior across full mission phases (e.g., ascent, on-orbit, entry, proximity operations)
  • Operational Readiness & Real-Time Support
    • Develop and execute operational concepts for GNC systems in mission or test environments
    • Monitor vehicle performance and make time-critical recommendations during dynamic operations
    • Support anomaly resolution, fault response strategies, and contingency planning
  • Requirements, Tools & Procedures
    • Define system and console requirements for monitoring and commanding GNC subsystems
    • Develop operator displays, telemetry utilization strategies, and command interfaces
    • Maintain flight rules, procedures, and operational documentation
  • Testing & Validation
    • Support system-level testing (integrated labs, simulations, hardware-in-the-loop environments)
    • Participate in verification of telemetry, command pathways, and system responses
    • Contribute to development and validation of contingency commanding capabilities

Required Qualifications

  • TS/SCI Clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree in aerospace engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field (advanced degree preferred) and 10+ years of experience
  • Strong foundation in:
    • Orbital mechanics / astrodynamics
    • Control systems and state estimation
    • Guidance algorithms and vehicle dynamics
  • Experience working with:
    • Flight software or embedded systems
    • Real-time or near-real-time operational environments
    • Telemetry analysis and command/response systems
  • Demonstrated ability to:
    • Operate effectively under pressure and make timely, sound decisions
    • Communicate complex technical issues clearly and concisely
    • Work across multidisciplinary teams
  • Must be a U.S Citizen

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting mission operations or system operations in a control center or similar environment
  • Background in anomaly resolution, fault detection/isolation/recovery (FDIR), and contingency operations
  • Familiarity with simulation environments, integrated test labs, or hardware/software validation
  • Experience developing procedures, flight rules, or operator tools
  • Prior experience training or certifying personnel in technical or operational roles

What Sets a Strong Candidate Apart

  • Demonstrated ownership of end-to-end GNC capabilities (not just analysis, but how the system is used)
  • Ability to connect engineering design decisions to real-world operational impacts
  • Proven performance in high-stakes, time-critical environments
  • Strong judgment, accountability, and credibility with both engineers and operators
  • Comfort operating in “gray space” where processes aren’t fully defined

Basic Compensation:

Jobs on this contract range from $133,900 - $200,800.

The offered rate will be based on the position, contract affordability, the selected candidate’s working location, knowledge, skills, abilities, experience, and in consideration of internal parity.

 Additional Compensation:

  • KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short-term incentives, long-term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.


Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Silvus Technologies, a leading provider of advanced MANET and MIMO communications systems, is reshaping mesh network technology for mission-critical applications – on the ground, in the air and at sea. Its battle-proven StreamCaster family of MANET radios and proprietary MN-MIMO waveform provides the vital communications link for defense, law enforcement and public safety agencies around the world, and in the toughest operational environments.

Silvus Technologies is a wholly owned subsidiary of Motorola Solutions, Inc.


Job Description

Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “Keeping Our Heroes Connected”?


THE OPPORTUNITY

Silvus is seeking a Business Development Engineer, US Air Force to join the Applications Engineering team. This role is structured for early- to mid-career candidates seeking to bridge technical radio frequency capabilities with Department of the Air Force customer requirements and emerging trends.


Reporting to the Director of Applications Engineering, you will work alongside Engineering and Business Development teams to support US Air Force acquisition stakeholders. In this position, you will assist in demonstrating the technical capabilities, interoperability, and field-readiness of our StreamCaster MANET radio portfolio across airborne, surface, expeditionary airbase, and uncrewed environments. This role requires up to 50% travel for field tests, customer meetings, and demonstrations, with a 100% remote working option depending on location.


The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion.


ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist in analyzing US Air Force operational priorities (e.g., DAF Battle Network, Agile Combat Employment [ACE], Advanced Battle Management System [ABMS]) and mapping operational requirements to tactical radio solutions.
  • Support technical planning, network configuration, and live-on-the-air execution of field trials, modernizations, and user evaluations.
  • Collaborate with the Applications Engineering team to leverage continuous testing and competitive benchmarking data, helping verify that proposed solution architectures are technically sound.
  • Maintain close alignment with the Business Development team to support their ongoing technical needs and align work with established strategic priorities.
  • Assist in building and presenting technical demonstrations tailored to airborne, tactical edge, and expeditionary airbase networking needs.
  • Contribute technical input and review support for RFI/RFP proposal responses.
  • Perform market research to identify potential integrations with industry partners and test end-to-end network architectures.
  • Assist Business Development in engaging with technical stakeholders across Department of the Air Force Program Executive Offices (DAF PEO C3BM, PEO C3I&N), Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL), Air Force Life Cycle Management Center (AFLCMC), and Tactical Operations Center-Light (TOC-L) leads.
  • Serve as an internal voice for the Airman by gathering field feedback and operational requirements, helping translate them into product roadmap inputs, and tracking engineering progress against operational needs.
  • Perform other related duties of which the above are representative.
  • Travel Requirement – 50%; frequent travel to customer sites, research laboratories, and strategic field-testing environments.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related C5ISR field with 2–5 years of demonstrated experience in systems engineering, technical business development, or defense technology roles; OR High School Diploma/GED with 5+ years of relevant technical or defense experience.
  • Exposure to or working knowledge of Software-Defined Radios (SDRs), IP-based routing protocols, or tactical communication systems.
  • Basic familiarity with RF test equipment, such as spectrum analyzers and signal generators.
  • Security Clearance: Active U.S. Government SECRET clearance or the ability to obtain one within 15 months of hire.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen due to clients under U.S. government contracts.
  • All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check and drug test.

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Basic understanding of Department of the Air Force tactical procurement pathways (DAF PEO C3BM, PEO C3I&N, AFLCMC, AFRL), network modernization priorities (DAF Battle Network, ACE, ABMS), or Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) / uncrewed systems integration.
  • Familiarity with wireless communication systems and RF signal propagation dynamics (e.g., air-to-ground, air-to-air, and high-mobility mesh links).
  • Practical experience with TCP/IP networking, Linux environments, or scripting languages (e.g., Python, C++) for test automation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to explain technical concepts effectively.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote team setting.

WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Conferences, technical symposiums, and trade shows.
  • Outdoor environment for large-scale field trials and tactical demonstrations.
  • Occasional exposure to heat, cold, and allergens while performing tests or demonstrations in rugged field environments.

raw.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Sicherheitsrisiken früh erkennen und wirksam in Produktentscheidungen verankern

Als Product Security Specialist (m/w/d) unterstützt du Produkt und Engineering Teams dabei, sichere Software und Plattformen über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus hinweg zu entwickeln. Du verbindest technische Security Expertise mit einem pragmatischen Ansatz und arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung, Architektur und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen, um Sicherheitsrisiken zu bewerten und passende Maßnahmen umzusetzen.

Die Position ist zu 100 % remote und kann vollständig ortsunabhängig in Deutschland ausgeübt werden.

Was du bewirkst

  • Begleitest Softwareprodukte und Plattformen durchgängig aus Security Perspektive, von Architektur und Design Reviews bis zu Code Reviews
  • Übernimmst Verantwortung für sicherheitsrelevante Herausforderungen über mehrere Produktteams hinweg, gibst technische Orientierung und setzt bei Bedarf Lösungen selbst um
  • Erstellst Threat Models und Security Assessments und verfolgst identifizierte Risiken bis zur Mitigation oder einer formalen Risikoentscheidung
  • Bewertest Sicherheitsrisiken von AI und LLM basierten Produktfunktionen und Services und definierst geeignete Guardrails und Kontrollen
  • Etablierst schlanke, risikobasierte Security Review Gates im Entwicklungsprozess, damit Security frühzeitig und gezielt einbezogen wird
  • Unterstützt die Security Integration neu übernommener oder neu angebundener Produkte sowie deren Migration auf gemeinsame Plattformen
  • Arbeitest mit Engineering Teams, Architekt:innen sowie lokalen und globalen Security Stakeholdern zusammen, um Sicherheitsmaßnahmen konsistent und risikobasiert umzusetzen

Was du mitbringst

  • Verfügst über ein fundiertes Verständnis von Softwarearchitekturen und Secure SDLC Prinzipien
  • Bringst Erfahrung mit Threat Modeling Methoden und Security Architecture Reviews mit
  • Kannst Source Code, Repositories und CI/CD Konfigurationen lesen und bewerten, um sicherheitsrelevante Schwachstellen zu erkennen
  • Verstehst spezifische Sicherheitsrisiken von AI und LLM basierten Anwendungen sowie entsprechende Gegenmaßnahmen, beispielsweise im Kontext der OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
  • Kennst relevante Standards und regulatorische Anforderungen wie ISO 27001, Cyber Resilience Act, GDPR, BSI C5 und OWASP und kannst daraus praktische Anforderungen ableiten
  • Bringst mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in Application Security, Product Security, Cloud Security, Security Engineering oder in der Softwareentwicklung mit starkem Security Fokus mit
  • Hast ein Studium der Informatik, Informationssicherheit oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung abgeschlossen oder verfügst über eine vergleichbare berufliche Qualifikation
  • Kommunizierst schriftlich und mündlich sehr sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdergruppen

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Kennst regulierte oder Compliance geprägte Umfelder, beispielsweise Healthcare oder ISO 27001 zertifizierte Organisationen
  • Hast Erfahrung mit Penetrationstests oder mit der Behebung daraus resultierender Findings
  • Verfügst über relevante Zertifizierungen wie AWS Certified Security Specialty, OSCP, CSSLP oder CISSP und Erfahrung in internationaler sowie funktionsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit

Das zeichnet dich aus

  • Analytische Stärke Du bewertest komplexe Sachverhalte strukturiert und priorisierst Risiken pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert
  • Eigenverantwortung Du organisierst deine Themen selbstständig und treibst sie über mehrere Produkte und parallele Workstreams hinweg voran
  • Kommunikationsstärke Du erklärst technische Risiken verständlich gegenüber Engineers, Management und Kund:innen
  • Überzeugungsfähigkeit Du hinterfragst konstruktiv und bringst Stakeholder über Funktionen und Senioritätslevel hinweg zusammen

Unsere Benefits für dich

  • Du entscheidest: Hansefit, EGYM Wellpass, Kinderbetreuung oder JobRad – wir unterstützen Dich flexibel mit einem Zuschuss von bis zu 60 € monatlich. Zusätzlich profitierst Du von exklusiven Vergünstigungen mit Corporate Benefits
  • Du kannst auf uns zählen – TELUS Health stärkt Dich mit individuellen Angeboten für Deine mentale Gesundheit
  • Wir gestalten Deine Entwicklung – mit LinkedIn Learning hast Du Zugriff auf inspirierende Lerninhalte und praxisnahe Weiterbildung, die Dich wirklich voranbringen
  • Wir denken an Deine Zukunft – mit unserem Aktienkaufprogramm kannst Du direkt am Unternehmenserfolg teilhaben, und durch unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) sicherst Du Dir finanzielle Stabilität für die Zukunft
  • Du hast 30 Tage Urlaubsanspruch, um ausreichend Zeit für Erholung und persönliche Interessen zu haben

MEDIFOX DAN

MEDIFOX DAN Gruppe mit Hauptsitz in Hildesheim gehört zur Resmed Corp. und beschäftigt über 900 Mitarbeitende an neun Standorten. Wir setzen auf Teamgeist, Kundenorientierung und Leidenschaft und arbeiten an zukunftsweisenden Softwarelösungen im Gesundheits- und Sozialwesen, um Innovationen voranzutreiben. Seit über 30 Jahren revolutionieren wir die Pflegebranche und suchen Menschen, die eine Leidenschaft für Technik in einer starken Unternehmenskultur teilen.

raw.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

The Director, Global CMC Regulatory is a strategic leadership role responsible for developing, driving, and executing global commercial CMC regulatory strategies to secure and maintain marketing approvals for RevMed’s product portfolio worldwide.

This position provides leadership for commercial-stage CMC regulatory activities, including original marketing applications, global expansions, and post-approval lifecycle management. This role requires deep expertise in global commercial CMC regulatory frameworks, strong cross-functional leadership, and the ability to proactively anticipate regulatory risks while enabling business objectives.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and lead execution of effective global CMC regulatory strategies to support initial marketing approvals and lifecycle management of RevMed's product portfolio.

  • Oversee the preparation and submission of high-quality CMC dossiers for global marketing authorization applications and post-approval supplements/variations. Manage/lead interactions with Health Authorities as needed.

  • Assess the global regulatory implications of proposed CMC changes and provide proactive, risk-based guidance to optimize implementation and maintain compliance.

  • Interpret and apply global CMC regulatory guidance (FDA, EMA, ICH, PMDA, NMPA, MHRA, etc.) to ensure compliant and efficient regulatory pathways.

  • Anticipate regulatory risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies aligned with commercial timelines.

  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs, technical SMEs, and CROs to ensure alignment of global submission strategies while addressing region-specific CMC requirements and serve as the CMC regulatory representative on global commercial teams to provide guidance that enables efficient global execution.

  • Provide strategic leadership, mentorship, and technical guidance to junior team members to foster professional development and team performance.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Pharmaceutical Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or closely related scientific discipline.

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in pharmaceutical / biotech drug development, including at least 5 years of hands-on global CMC regulatory affairs experience.

  • Deep expertise in CMC development for new chemical entities (NCEs) and small molecules, with proven ability to manage complex technical content.

  • Extensive experience leading global CMC regulatory strategy and global marketing approval applications across the US, Canada, Europe, UK, APAC, and LATAM regions.

  • Strong knowledge of US and international GMP regulations, current industry practices, with a demonstrated ability to interpret and apply requirements across the product lifecycle.

  • Proven track record of building and maintaining productive relationships with global Health Authorities, including direct interactions with the FDA and other regulatory bodies.

  • Strong project and team leadership capabilities, with the ability to prioritize effectively, manage multiple complex programs, and foster cross-functional collaboration.

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal skills.

  • A collaborative, high-energy team player who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and embraces innovation and continuous improvement.

Preferred Skills:

  • Advanced degree (MS or Ph.D) in Pharmaceutical Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or closely related field.

  • Experience supporting global commercial labeling implementation and lifecycle updates, with strong knowledge of global labeling requirements and artwork development/approval processes, including coordination of CMC-related labeling impacts across regions.

  • Prior experience in oncology product commercialization is a plus.

raw.excerpt: About KIRAOur mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
raw.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

raw.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About the Role

This role carries a dual commercial mandate: leading Radiometer’s growth strategy across West Africa while developing funded and turnkey healthcare opportunities across the wider African region.

The successful candidate will combine strategic business development, channel leadership and complex project management with strong knowledge of African healthcare markets. The role requires the ability to build trusted relationships with government institutions, funding organizations, healthcare networks, distributors and turnkey providers—translating complex opportunities into sustainable and profitable growth for Radiometer.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership – West Africa

  • Develop and execute Radiometer’s commercial strategy to accelerate portfolio growth across West Africa.

  • Deliver annual sales, revenue, profitability, margin and market-share objectives.

  • Identify, qualify and convert new business opportunities across government, private healthcare, laboratory and institutional markets.

  • Drive customer engagement through value-based selling and consultative commercial approaches.

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans for key customers and healthcare networks.

  • Analyze market dynamics, competitor activity, healthcare funding trends and emerging opportunities to shape regional growth priorities.

  • Monitor channel-partner performance through structured business reviews, KPI tracking and market feedback.

  • Identify performance gaps within the channel network and recommend corrective actions, partner development plans or alternative partners when required to improve market coverage and business results.

Funded and Turnkey Project Development – Africa

  • Lead the identification, qualification and pursuit of funded healthcare projects across Africa.

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with:

    • International funding organizations

    • NGOs and implementing partners

    • Multilateral organizations

    • Ministries of Health

    • Government procurement agencies

    • Turnkey healthcare providers

  • Monitor donor-funded opportunities, public tenders, grants and strategic healthcare initiatives.

  • Develop project-pursuit strategies and coordinate bid and proposal activities.

  • Own Radiometer’s strategic relationship framework for turnkey partners, ensuring clear account ownership, stakeholder mapping, engagement cadence, opportunity prioritization and executive alignment.

  • Act as Radiometer’s central commercial owner for turnkey-provider relationships across the EEATR region.

  • Coordinate internal stakeholders to ensure Radiometer is engaged early, appropriately specified and consistently represented throughout complex healthcare infrastructure projects.

  • Build long-term relationships with turnkey providers to understand their project pipelines and influence solution design at an early stage.

  • Position Radiometer as a preferred partner for blood gas and acute-care diagnostic solutions within major turnkey healthcare projects.

  • Support contract negotiations and commercial agreements related to funded and turnkey opportunities.

  • Establish Radiometer as a trusted diagnostic-solutions partner for major healthcare projects across Africa.

Channel-Partner Management

  • Recruit, develop and manage high-performing distributors and channel partners across assigned territories.

  • Implement channel-excellence programs and structured performance-management processes.

  • Conduct regular business reviews, forecasting sessions and capability-development initiatives.

  • Ensure channel partners maintain the technical and commercial capabilities required to represent Radiometer effectively.

  • Establish clear targets, performance indicators and accountability measures for distributor partners.

  • Drive improved market coverage, opportunity development and customer support through the channel network.

Stakeholder and Relationship Management

  • Build trusted relationships with key healthcare decision-makers, influencers and clinical stakeholders.

  • Engage senior stakeholders across government institutions, donor organizations, healthcare groups and laboratory networks.

  • Represent Radiometer at industry events, conferences and relevant stakeholder forums.

  • Act as a strategic advisor to customers by understanding their clinical, operational and financial challenges.

  • Develop strong relationships with key turnkey providers, implementing partners and funding organizations.

  • Strengthen Radiometer’s access to major projects through early engagement, partner advocacy and consistent executive-level alignment.

Project Execution and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Sales, Service, Applications, Marketing, Finance, Regulatory and Supply Chain teams to support successful project delivery.

  • Manage opportunities from initial identification and qualification through contracting, implementation, commissioning and customer acceptance.

  • Coordinate cross-functional project activities and maintain alignment around timelines, responsibilities and customer expectations.

  • Identify and manage project-related risks while ensuring compliance with contractual obligations.

  • Drive customer satisfaction, retention and long-term partnership growth.

  • Ensure clear internal communication and executive visibility throughout major strategic pursuits.

Forecasting and Business Planning

  • Develop accurate sales forecasts, annual business plans and well-qualified opportunity pipelines.

  • Maintain strong pipeline discipline, including clear opportunity stages, values, timelines, risks and next actions.

  • Manage budgets and resources effectively to optimize commercial performance.

  • Deliver regular business reviews and performance reports to regional leadership.

  • Track progress against sales, profitability, market-share and strategic project objectives.

  • Ensure compliance with Danaher policies, industry regulations and ethical business practices.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Medical Technology, Biomedical Sciences, Life Sciences, Healthcare or a related discipline.

  • A postgraduate qualification in Business Management or an MBA would be advantageous.

Professional Experience

  • At least seven years of successful commercial experience within medical diagnostics, medical devices or the broader healthcare industry.

  • Demonstrated experience managing and developing business across African markets, particularly West Africa.

  • Proven track record of delivering profitable sales growth and achieving commercial targets.

  • Strong experience working with:

    • Donor-funded healthcare programs

    • International funding agencies

    • Implementing partners

    • NGOs

    • Government healthcare institutions

    • Ministries of Health

    • Turnkey healthcare providers

  • Experience leading large-scale healthcare projects, tenders or turnkey opportunities is highly desirable.

  • Demonstrated experience managing distributors and indirect sales channels across multiple countries.

  • Strong understanding of complex sales cycles, public procurement processes and stakeholder environments within African healthcare markets.

Critical Competencies

Commercial Excellence

  • Strategic sales and territory planning

  • Business development and market expansion

  • Opportunity qualification and pipeline management

  • Value-based and consultative selling

  • Commercial negotiation and influencing

  • Strategic-account development

  • Distributor and channel-performance management

  • Financial and commercial awareness

Project and Stakeholder Management

  • Funded-project identification and development

  • Tender and proposal management

  • Complex project-pursuit planning

  • Cross-functional leadership

  • Executive stakeholder engagement

  • Customer and partner relationship management

  • Contract negotiation and risk management

  • Ability to navigate complex institutional environments

Personal Attributes

  • Results-oriented with a strong focus on execution.

  • Strategic thinker capable of translating market insights into practical growth plans.

  • Proactive, entrepreneurial and comfortable creating opportunities in developing markets.

  • Highly organized, with strong planning and prioritization skills.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Adaptable and resilient within complex and changing environments.

  • Collaborative and able to influence stakeholders without direct authority.

  • Strong sense of ownership, integrity and accountability.

  • Culturally aware and effective in diverse, multinational environments.

Language Requirements

  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

  • Fluent French, written and spoken—mandatory.

  • Proficiency in additional African languages would be advantageous.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be assessed through:

  • Achievement of annual sales, profitability and margin targets.

  • Growth of Radiometer’s market share across West Africa.

  • Value and quality of funded and turnkey projects secured across Africa.

  • Strength and maturity of Radiometer’s strategic relationships with turnkey providers.

  • Early access to major healthcare infrastructure projects and repeat inclusion in strategic opportunities.

  • Expansion, capability and performance of the distributor and channel-partner network.

  • Customer satisfaction, retention and long-term account development.

  • Forecast accuracy and quality of the commercial opportunity pipeline.

  • Successful execution of strategic healthcare projects.

  • Compliance with Radiometer and Danaher policies and ethical business standards.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a commercially driven healthcare professional who has successfully developed business across African healthcare markets and understands the donor-funded healthcare ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong network across Ministries of Health, funding organizations, implementing partners, government institutions and turnkey providers. They will combine strategic business-development expertise with the commercial discipline and stakeholder-management capabilities required to convert large, complex opportunities into sustainable growth.

This is an excellent opportunity for an entrepreneurial commercial leader who wants to shape Radiometer’s growth across West Africa while contributing to transformative healthcare projects throughout Africa.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

About SiTime

SiTime is the Precision Timing company.

Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.

Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com.

Job Summary

The Quality Engineer II is responsible for maintaining SiTime’s Quality management system used in the design and manufacturing of SiTime’s revolutionary MEMS-based timing products. Responsibilities include being the primary focal for all environmental quality aspects by working with our suppliers/vendors and support all other aspects of quality management system like facilitating our change management system and be able to perform internal and supplier audits, etc. It is not necessary to meet all job requirements to be a qualified candidate for the position.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for responding to all environmental & customer surveys by working with internal stakeholders as well as suppliers.
  • Maintain SiTime’s Environmental documentation (Reach, RoHS, IMDS, CAMDS, IPC1752 & custom formats).
  • Monitor material declaration documents from suppliers and keep them current.
  • Perform supplier audits and monitor supplier processes to trigger continuous improvements.
  • Generate material composition reports as applicable (E.g.: New products, material change, etc.) and maintain them in the document control system.
  • Ability to perform audits per ISO9001:2015 standard as well as applicable customer specific requirements.
  • Facilitate in dispositioning non-conforming material.
  • Run Change control board activities to properly document the changes and release to Eng/Manufacturing including customer notifications.
  • Support reviewing and effective closing of corrective actions as well as continuous improvements.
  • Learn and respond to other customer requests pertaining to SiTime’s products and quality management system as tasked.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Diploma or Degree in Electronics/Mechanical/Environmental Safety or Chemical.
  • Minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in the Semiconductor industry
  • Proficient in Microsoft Suite (E.g: Excel, PowerPoint, Word, etc)
  • Strong diagnostic and problem-solving skills.
  • Able to support overtime if needed.
  • Proficiency in English.

Desired Characteristics & Attributes:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to think outside the box in streamlining processes to help improve efficiency and effectiveness
  • Good interpersonal skills
  • Self-motivated

Compensation Range:

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of innovation goals—reflecting our commitment to recognizing meaningful impact. We also offer equity grants, providing a meaningful opportunity to share in the company’s future growth and success.

SiTime is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law.

raw.description:
Job Description:

Job Description – Product Owner

As the Product Owner for ProviderSoft, you will be accountable for translating product priorities into clear, execution-ready work that advances our mission: to empower Early Childhood Development providers with the software, service, and expertise they need to achieve operational excellence, enabling them to deliver the highest quality care to children and families within their communities.

You will sit inside Engineering, reporting to the Director of Engineering, and partner closely with Client Services, Sales, and leadership across the business.


A key competency of this role is fluency with AI-Directed development workflows. This goes beyond using AI tools to draft user stories. You will use AI to elaborate functional specifications to a quality bar where the development team can build with minimal clarification, accelerating discovery, design, and delivery while preserving the workflow integrity that our clients depend on for daily operations.


ProviderSoft supports complex, real-world agency operations across case management, scheduling, billing, regulatory reporting, and back-office workflows. You will ensure the delivery team has precise requirements, clear priorities, and shared understanding while preserving workflow integrity for agencies running mission-critical daily operations.

Compensation & Role Details:

Expected Salary Range: The expected base salary range for this role is between $75,000-85,000 CAD, depending on experience and qualifications

Role Type: Backfill

AI Disclosure: AI may be used during the hiring process.


Responsibilities

  • Client Discovery & Requirements Integrity

  • Run a structured client feedback program: interviews, CS and Sales intake, and theme synthesis that informs roadmap discussions
  • Translate agency, operational, and internal stakeholder needs into detailed, unambiguous requirements
  • Ensure workflows reflect how ProviderSoft is used in production environments, including billing, case management, and regulatory reporting processes
  • Identify edge cases, configuration impacts, dependencies, and data implications early in the lifecycle
  • Surface underutilized features and pain points through usage data and client conversation

  • AI-Elaborated Specification & Solution Design

  • Produce functional specifications structured and complete enough to serve as direct input to development, with materially reduced clarifying exchanges between product and engineering
  • Build and refine AI-assisted spec workflows that advance the team's AI-Directed practice
  • Contribute to the continued evolution of our AI-Directed Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), refining workflows, tooling, and team practices as we deepen AI fluency across the team
  • Translate client problems into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and interactive mockups
  • Maintain and evolve UI and UX standards across the product as we modernize legacy functionality into Vue
  • Vet designs with internal stakeholders and incorporate feedback through visible iteration

  • Backlog Ownership & Delivery Clarity

  • Own and maintain the ProviderSoft product backlog, aligned to platform priorities and roadmap direction
  • Triage incoming cases and prioritize against client value, delivery cost, and operational stability
  • Triage and influence prioritization of technical debt and maintenance work alongside new capability development, partnering with engineering leadership on the balance
  • Drive triage efficiency so that most cases are tagged, valued, and routed within two weeks of creation
  • Maintain backlog readiness to support predictable sprint planning and delivery execution
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day product contact for the ProviderSoft delivery team, actively removing blockers by resolving requirement gaps and priority conflicts

  • Release Readiness & Stakeholder Communication

  • Facilitate the creation of test plans, with QA generating test cases from specs in advance of development where possible
  • Perform user acceptance testing once development completes, validating against acceptance criteria and real-world workflows
  • Ensure release notes, documentation inputs, and internal enablement materials are complete and accurate
  • Partner with Client Services on change communications so clients understand what is shipping and why
  • Monitor post-release adoption and feedback, coordinate follow-up work as needed

  • Documentation & Modernization Awareness

  • Treat documentation as a first-class deliverable. Your specifications and updates feed into a functional documentation pipeline that supports AI-assisted development, defect resolution, and onboarding
  • Contribute requirements and clarity for initiatives spanning legacy and modernized parts of the platform
  • Help evolve ProviderSoft in alignment with long-term UI, architecture, and ecosystem goals while respecting current client realities

Required Experience & Capabilities

  • 3 to 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or in a similar delivery-focused product role in B2B SaaS
  • Demonstrated experience producing structured specifications that developers can build from without extensive clarification
  • Working AI fluency. You actively use Claude, Copilot, or similar tools in your daily craft and can speak to specific workflows you have built
  • Experience running customer discovery: interviews, feedback synthesis, translating qualitative input into prioritized work
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to clarify ambiguity and produce specifications, user stories, release notes, and stakeholder updates without external help
  • Comfort with mockup and prototyping tools such as Figma or Balsamiq, with a real point of view on UI and UX quality
  • Strong experience defining requirements for complex, workflow-driven, or legacy-rich platforms

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience leading or championing AI-Directed development practices within a product or engineering team, including evolving workflow design, tooling choices, and team adoption
  • UX and design depth beyond mockups: design systems thinking, user research methods, accessibility awareness
  • Working fluency with product analytics (feature adoption, usage telemetry, funnel analysis)
  • Healthcare, EdTech, or regulated-industry SaaS experience
  • Experience working in or near a legacy modernization effort, comfortable writing specifications that span old and new architecture
  • Experience with hosted enterprise operational software serving diverse customer operating models


About ProviderSoft


ProviderSoft was the dream product of a pediatric physical therapist and Early Intervention agency owner. The challenge was to effectively and efficiently manage business, and to stay ahead of the curve. A solution of technology was explored, and years were dedicated to designing, developing, and testing a prototype.


With the help of the prototype, the Agency was able to grow from a small organization servicing families in the immediate area, to include hundreds of providers servicing over 1500 children and their families. It was the ability to increase productivity, maximize service delivery, carefully track referrals, monitor performance, meet all expected deadlines, decrease expenses, and exceed the standards during audits that facilitated this growth.


ProviderSoft became a standalone technology firm in 2007, having successfully evolved from the experimental stage into a viable commercial software as a service company serving agencies across the nation. We are constantly striving to improve usability, performance, and feature-sets, and are constantly evolving to meet the ever-changing needs of health and education regulations. We do this by employing industry specialists, and of course, listening to the needs of our clients.


Location

Your home! ProviderSoft's regular office is a virtual network. Each member of the team works from home communicating via Teams and coordinating with online project management tools. We also hold office space in Warminster, PA for when the need or desire arises to work face-to-face.

Business Unit:

ProviderSoft - Canada

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

37.5

Number of Openings Available:

1

Worker Type:

Regular

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

raw.description:
Job Description:

Job Summary

We are looking for a hard-working, competent, and adaptable attorney to support our rapidly growing and evolving Pluralsight teams. This position will focus primarily on Privacy, Product and Marketing compliance, SaaS contract review and negotiation, Intellectual Property (including trademarks and marketing IP), while also providing legal counsel on a range of Product and Marketing-related matters, including AI/ML and the EU AI Act. The role will also support the broader legal team, as available and as needed, in other substantive areas.


What you’ll do

The right candidate for this position will assist the Chief AI, Privacy and Digital Risk Counsel across four areas of focus:

Privacy, Cybersecurity and AI

  • Provide guidance to key internal stakeholders (PrivacyOps, Marketing, Product, Tech, Finance, Support, and Employment) on privacy, AI, and security matters
  • Maintain a working knowledge of privacy and AI laws and regulations, including GDPR, CCPA, sectoral privacy laws, and the EU AI Act, and keep up with emerging regulation
  • Maintain, develop, and evolve privacy notices, policies, procedures, DPIAs, and DPAs, including subprocessor determinations and notifications, and support internal training
  • Oversee the DSAR process, subprocessor audits, and Trust Center content, directing outside counsel on escalated DSARs, complaints and disputes, annual policy and playbook updates, and process and website audits
  • Provide AI guidance and support AI product development, including AI assessments, AI vendor reviews, disclaimer guidance, and EU AI Act compliance
  • Work closely with the Data Governance team on global privacy initiatives in furtherance of Pluralsight's legal obligations to protect the data of our customers, employees, vendors, and other third parties
  • Review and maintain customer and vendor security and privacy questionnaires (such as SIG and CAIQ) and related field guidance documents, and regularly review and maintain Data Privacy/Cyber Security, Marketing, and AI handbooks and job aids
  • Support the CISO org during a Security Incident, including regulatory and customer notification, contractual requirements, root cause analysis reviews, and internal and external communications
  • Assist with annual ISO and SOC assessments and audits, and review and update relevant GRC policies annually for legal and regulatory changes

SaaS Contracts, Technology Transactions and Partnerships

  • Review, draft, and negotiate SaaS agreements, DPAs, NDAs, vendor agreements, and partnerships, with a focus on privacy and AI/ML terms, balancing risk with business goals
  • Review high-priority contracts and procurement requests, and handle escalations on contract terms and obligations (for example, export control and government customer terms)
  • Scope and conduct initial legal reviews of partnership initiatives, such as content, channel, and technology partnerships
  • Direct outside counsel on in-depth technical reviews of major contracts as needed
  • Create and enforce templates, and keep playbooks, written guidance, and talking points current for the Contracts and Sales teams on recurring Privacy, Cybersecurity, IP, and AI/ML topics, including quarterly training meetings
  • Assist the demanding business teams in responding promptly to legal inquiries on customer and vendor questionnaires
  • Review and keep up with emerging regulations as they apply to customer, vendor, and partner agreements and the Products and Marketing we support

Marketing IP, Trademarks, Copyright and Brand

  • Review marketing collateral, content, Help Center articles, sales enablement materials, and promotional campaigns for copyright, licensing, third-party rights, claims, and disclaimers, flagging risks
  • Maintain a working knowledge of marketing and advertising laws, including CAN-SPAM, TCPA, DNC, telephone marketing, cookie consent, and the FTC Negative Option Rule, and guide Marketing accordingly
  • Assist with trademark matters, including clearance, registration, portfolio maintenance, enforcement, and brand protection escalations
  • Advise on copyright, ® marks, and publication review for content and author materials
  • Maintain brand guidelines and guide teams on their proper use
  • Support patent filings and IP agreement creation and negotiation in close collaboration with outside counsel
  • Advise on IP issues in product development, including AI/ML training data, outputs, and open source

Product Development and Other Legal Support

  • Support product and project development from inception to GTM and EOL, including project scoping, initial technical legal reviews, and regular product meetings
  • Provide regular guidance to Technical Support, Sales, Authors, Marketing, Security, and other teams on Product and Privacy issues, including support escalations
  • Work with outside counsel and a paralegal or assistant to delegate routine and specialized work, and help evaluate that model
  • Coordinate with Finance and Corporate Legal, and drive process improvements
  • Support other legal initiatives and special projects when needed

Experience you’ll bring

  • Substantial experience reviewing and negotiating SaaS agreements, including data processing, security, liability, and AI/ML-related terms
  • Strong working knowledge of privacy law and practice, with hands-on experience in DPAs, DPIAs, and customer privacy and security questionnaires
  • Good communication (oral and written) and interpersonal skills within and across departments and externally; must be proactive in providing counsel to clients
  • Sound judgment; ability to clearly make reasoned recommendations; ability to cross-think and determine who should be kept informed
  • Self-starter with good business sense and a sense of urgency, honesty, and fairness
  • Excellent team player, calm under pressure, with a can-do attitude
  • In-house experience with a technology/SaaS company

  • Experience working with external regulators and customers
  • Experience with technology transactions and partnerships (content, channel, and technology), including working with outside counsel on in-depth reviews

  • Comfort managing outside counsel and working with paralegal or assistant support to scale the team

Who you’re committed to being

  • A go-getter with a can-do attitude who takes ownership, finds a path to yes, and gets things across the finish line

Why you’ll love working here

About us

Pluralsight provides the only learning platform dedicated to accelerating the technology skills and capabilities of today’s tech workforce.
