raw.description:
Join our growing People team! We're hiring a Senior People Partner to own the people agenda for our Product organisation and a set of global functions sitting at the centre of how M-KOPA operates

The Impact 🌍

Your leadership will directly shape how we build, retain and grow the engineering talent powering our mission. We've now reached 10 million customers and unlocked $2+ billion in credit across five African markets. This role sits right at the centre of the machine that makes that growth possible.

The Opportunity

💚 Mission-driven HR: Partner with product, design and digital lending leaders building the customer experience for millions, plus our fraud, workplaces, impact and corporate communications and marketing teams

🏆 Global recognition: Join a company named by TIME 100 as one of the world's most influential, and by the Financial Times as Africa's fastest-growing company for 5 consecutive years (2022–2026)

🚀 Scale challenges: Build credibility across a genuinely varied portfolio — creative and iterative teams like product and design sit alongside operational, market-specific, high-stakes teams like fraud and workplaces

🌱 Environmental impact: Work for a carbon-negative company that has displaced over 2 million tonnes of CO₂ emissions

What You'll Do

You'll be a trusted advisor to our product, design and digital lending leaders, aligning people strategy to product delivery and team evolution, while also owning the people agenda for fraud, workplaces, impact and corporate communications and marketing across multiple markets and operating models. It's a portfolio with unusual variety — succeeding here means switching register comfortably and building credibility with very different kinds of leaders, from a design team to a fraud operations team in the same day.

Day to day, you'll:

  • Support org design and change: contribute to team transformations, workforce planning and structural change across your client groups

  • Build capability in managers: develop the people management standard across your portfolio, from performance conversations to hiring and development

  • Scale and retain talent: implement approaches to attract, develop and retain product, design and analytics talent in a competitive market

  • Use people analytics to inform action: work with Centres of Excellence and your clients to turn data into insight and insight into action

  • Own employee relations: manage cases across your portfolio, working with our ER Centre of Excellence on the complex end

  • Embed our culture: reinforce M-KOPA's values at every touchpoint, from performance and development to feedback loops and rituals

Your Environment 💻

  • Reporting line: Lead People Partner, Technology — working closely together on the shared technology and product agenda, with real ownership of your own client groups from day one

  • Client groups: Product, Design and Digital Lending leadership, plus Fraud, Workplaces, Impact, and Corporate Communications and Marketing

  • Population: spans multiple markets and operating models, from globally distributed creative teams to market-specific operational teams

Our Approach

  • We expect you to switch register comfortably — building credibility with creative, iterative teams and operational, high-stakes teams in the same portfolio

  • We lean on Centres of Excellence for data and specialist ER support, so you can focus on judgement and stakeholder relationships rather than carrying every case alone

  • We see this as a role with real ownership from day one, not just a supporting seat

  • We expect close collaboration with the Lead People Partner for Technology on the shared technology and product agenda

What You Need

We're looking for someone who has partnered with senior leaders in a scaling technology, fintech or high-growth business, and has owned a portfolio rather than supported one.

Required Experience:

  • HR business partnering experience with senior leaders in a scaling technology, fintech or high-growth business, with portfolio ownership

  • Exposure to product, design, marketing or analytics teams, and an understanding of how they're built, motivated and retained

  • Breadth and adaptability: comfortable moving between very different teams (e.g. a design team and a fraud operations team) in the same day

  • Strategic and operational range: comfortable shaping longer-term plans and delivering the day-to-day work that makes them real

  • Remote and global savvy: experience supporting cross-cultural teams across multiple regions

  • Analytical and advisory instinct: uses data, influence and judgement to advise leaders on trade-offs and risks

  • Confident handling employee relations matters across more than one jurisdiction, partnering with an ER Centre of Excellence rather than carrying every case alone (Europe/UK exposure is a plus, not a requirement)

Location & Benefits

  • Hybrid Working: 1-2 days on-site per week in Lagos office

  • Reports to the Lead People Partner, Technology

  • Room to grow your own scope, with mentorship from a senior partner who owns the wider technology and product portfolio

  • Professional development and coaching partnerships

  • Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model, driving greater inclusion of women, youth and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

  • Included 🔓: 10 million customers, $2+ billion in credit unlocked since 2010

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use their M-KOPA product for income generation, 35,000 livelihoods created for sales agents

  • Green 🌱: over 2.1 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided, with 127,700 circular economy products sold since 2010

Ready to bring breadth and adaptability to a portfolio that shapes how millions of people experience M-KOPA? Apply today!

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.


NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to drive technical engagement with OEM and deployment partners across the AI Infrastructure Build Readiness - Execution team. In this role, you'll connect real-world customer workloads to NVIDIA's hardware and software ecosystem, helping developers and enterprises adopt and scale our platforms. We're looking for someone with strong technical depth who can serve as a trusted advisor, bridge complex challenges to innovative solutions, and grow into a strategic resource for the customers and partners you support. If you're excited about applied technology and enabling others to succeed with advanced platforms, we'd love to hear from you.


What you'll be doing:

  • Serve as a trusted advisor who understands complex or large-scale customer workloads and maps them to NVIDIA's technology stack to achieve measurable outcomes.
  • Co-design advanced, scalable architectures with OEM and deployment partners, defining technical direction, integration milestones, and deployment plans.
  • Engage hands-on with deep technical topics—designing, validating, and supporting solutions that enable customer and partner success.
  • Identify gaps between OEM and deployment partner needs and NVIDIA offerings, communicating insights that shape internal product and engineering priorities.
  • Lead technical engagements, helping customers troubleshoot, resolve complex issues, and advocate for their technical needs.
  • Drive technical enablement and platform adoption, helping developers and enterprises integrate NVIDIA SDKs, frameworks, and systems.
  • Partner cross-functionally with engineering and product teams to ensure successful deployment and continuous improvement of NVIDIA solutions.
  • Lead AI Factory build execution engagements with OEM and deployment partners, driving technical readiness, deployment validation, and issue resolution across NVIDIA AI infrastructure build-outs.

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of professional experience spanning software/hardware engineering, developer relations, technical partnerships, solutions architecture, or product management — with 3-5+ years of direct, hands-on experience in AI infrastructure, data center deployment, or large-scale AI/HPC systems.
  • Deep technical expertise in high-performance computing, AI/ML, data center infrastructure, rack-scale AI infrastructure, or large-scale GPU systems, with a track record of driving product integrations and contributing to software and hardware platforms, systems, and libraries.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and a commitment to helping customers succeed.
  • A track record of balancing empathy for OEM and deployment partner needs with the ability to drive complex product decisions through trusted relationships.
  • Experience working with OEM, ODM, system integrator, or deployment partner ecosystems to drive technical field engagement, partner enablement, or platform adoption at scale.
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU, networking, and AI infrastructure platforms, with a track record of driving integrations in large-scale deployment environments.
  • Experience working with services, field engineering, professional services, manufacturing partners, or deployment services teams.
  • Travel required (up to 50%) to support field engagements, partner sites, and deployment activities.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • A hands-on technical expert and problem solver who can clearly describe solution paths for complex challenges.
  • History of enabling customers and/or partners to successfully adopt NVIDIA technologies and platforms.
  • A technical vision that influences product and engineering decisions and drives production outcomes.
  • Experience with AI Factory, accelerated computing, rack-scale AI infrastructure, or large-scale GPU system deployments.
  • Experience contributing to deployment playbooks, execution frameworks, or readiness programs for large-scale AI infrastructure build-outs.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 16, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

This role is for a strategic, customer-facing architect who can help customers modernize content operations for the AI era. You will work with customers and prospects to understand their goals, capture requirements, shape scope, and translate complex needs into compelling solution direction that connects Adobe technology to clear business value.

While a strong foundation in CMS platforms and Adobe Experience Manager is essential, this is not simply a product architecture role. We are looking for someone who can elevate customer conversations—helping organizations rethink how content is planned, created, governed, activated, and optimized through Content Supply Chain, AI-enabled workflows, and emerging agentic approaches.

You will act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders ranging from business leaders to technical teams, using your CMS and digital experience background to bring credibility to strategic discussions. Working closely with Sales, Delivery, Product, and Partner teams, you will lead discovery, shape roadmaps, create compelling presentations and proposals, and help customers understand how Adobe can accelerate transformation across content operations, experience delivery, and long-term innovation.

This is a highly collaborative, customer-facing role suited to someone who combines strategic thinking, technical credibility, and strong communication skills to help customers move from vision to action.

The role requires travel across EMEA of up to 30%.

What you’ll do:

  • Capture and translate customer needs into clear solution strategies, recommendations, scoped proposals, and phased roadmaps

raw.excerpt: About FringeFringe is a fast-growing HR technology company based in Virginia.
raw.description:
About Fringe

Fringe is a fast-growing HR technology company based in Virginia. Founded in late 2018, Fringe is the first ever platform for personalized lifestyle benefits. We are a relentlessly people-focused group revolutionizing the way employers care for their people in the benefits space. We're a supportive, down-to-earth team, fully committed to the belief that relationships fuel outstanding client experience.

We built Fringe to give companies a better way to show love and care to their people. Because we believe it's the people who really matter. Companies exist because of the products and services they offer, but we believe the people within them should come first. At Fringe, this is the way we live.

Practically, this means we hire people who care about their teammates just as much as (if not more than) themselves. We hire people who are genuine, humble, willing to learn, ready to teach, able to adapt, flex, collaborate, celebrate each other, win together and lose together.

We're a startup, and that means we must be a courageous group. We solve problems all day, but we also mess up sometimes. We extend grace to each other, and we try again. We aren't looking for perfect people. We're looking for people who own their faults, play to their strengths, and have the courage to simply be the same person all the time.

If that doesn't sound like your cup of cold brew, no hard feelings. But that's exactly who we are and what you can expect when you work at Fringe.

About the Role

Fringe reaches employers two ways: directly, by working with HR leaders who want a better way to care for their people, and through partners like ADP, where Fringe is available to the employers who already trust ADP to run their HR and payroll. Partner-sourced deals move differently. They're warmer, faster, and come with a partner in the room. Direct deals take more discovery, more storytelling, and more hustle. We need someone who's great at both.

You'll be an Account Executive focused on ADP-specific opportunities, alongside a book of our smaller direct deals. You'll own your pipeline from first conversation to signed contract, work closely with our partnership team and ADP's sales teams, and partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer Success, and Product to make sure every new client gets off to a great start.

This is a role for a seller who loves variety and wants to help build something. The ADP motion is still growing, which means you'll do more than close deals. You'll help shape the playbook. It's a lot of hats and a rare amount of ownership, visibility, and impact.

Reports to: Senior Director of Growth

What you'll own

ADP partnership deals

  • Run ADP-sourced opportunities end to end: discovery, demo, proposal, and close, often on a much faster timeline than a traditional sales cycle.
  • Build trusted relationships with ADP sales reps and partner teams so Fringe is top of mind when their clients ask about recognition, rewards, and employee experience.
  • Learn the ADP co-sell motion inside and out, and help turn what works into a repeatable playbook.
  • Hand off cleanly to Customer Success so partner-sourced clients launch quickly and see value from day one.

Direct opportunities

  • Own a pipeline of smaller direct deals, typically HR leaders at growing companies who wear a lot of hats.
  • Run sharp, tailored demos that show how Fringe helps a small HR team deliver a best-in-class employee experience without juggling a pile of vendors.
  • Work inbound leads, referrals, and targeted outbound with intention and consistent follow-through.
  • Keep Salesforce clean, your pipeline current, and your forecast honest.

Cross-functional partner

  • Collaborate with Partnerships, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product to win deals together and set clients up for success.
  • Bring back what you're hearing from prospects and partners, and help sharpen our pitch, our process, and our product.

Who you are

  • A natural self-starter. You build your own momentum, manage your own day, and don't need someone looking over your shoulder to hit your number.
  • Versatile. You can run a fast, partner-sourced deal in the morning and a thoughtful direct discovery call in the afternoon, and you enjoy the switch.
  • Open-minded and coachable. You're curious about new ways of selling, welcome feedback, and adapt quickly when something isn't working.
  • A true collaborator. You know the best deals are won together, and you treat partners and teammates like they're on your team, because they are.
  • Someone who owns mistakes, extends grace, and shows up as the same person every day. That's who we are.

Need to haves

  • 3–5 years of B2B sales experience, with a track record of meeting or exceeding quota.
  • Experience owning the full sales cycle, from discovery through close.
  • Comfort managing multiple deals at once, at different speeds and stages.
  • Strong discovery, presentation, and demo skills, with the ability to communicate value to HR leaders and executives.
  • Familiarity with a modern sales tech stack (Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Google Workspace, Claude, or similar).
  • Self-directed and organized, with the discipline to thrive in a remote role.
  • Quality communicator, written and verbal.

Nice to haves

  • Experience selling HR technology or into HR, benefits, or people teams.
  • SaaS sales experience.
  • Experience working with channel partners, resellers, or co-selling alongside a larger platform. ADP experience is a big plus.

What we offer

Fringe is remote-first, with an office in Richmond, VA for those who want it. Beyond the scope of the role itself, here's what comes with it:

  • Competitive salary.
  • Employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for individuals and families.
  • 3% company match on 401(k) retirement contributions.
  • Unlimited paid time off (2 weeks minimum per year), plus paid holidays, volunteer days, quarterly wellbeing days off, and parental leave.
  • Employee stock options so you can participate in our success.
  • Your choice of monthly Fringe lifestyle benefits on our own marketplace. We use what we build.
  • Free access to DoorDash DashPass & Cloverleaf for personal and team development
  • Company-sponsored team events, in person and virtually.
Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 / year

raw.excerpt: At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU!  Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers.
raw.description:
At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package - this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!

Not every fiber market is the same — and a playbook that pretends otherwise loses before it starts. The Hyperlocal Playbook, Sr Mgr is the person who builds the intelligence layer behind T-Mobile Fiber's field strategy: defining market archetypes, identifying the winning plays for each, and building a living playbook that tells the field team exactly what to do, when, and why — based on the specific conditions in front of them. This isn't a role that publishes a document once a year. It's a role that systematically learns what drives penetration in different market types, codifies those learnings into replicable strategies, and continuously updates the playbook as markets evolve and new data emerges.

This role works at the intersection of data and execution. They partner closely with analysts to understand what's working, what isn't, and why — then translate those findings into specific tactical recommendations that field teams can act on. They hold the standards for how the field approaches different market conditions, and they build the tools, frameworks, and guidance that make those standards operational. The goal: the right campaign, the right tactics, in the right market, at the right time — every time.

Working Conditions

  • Travel required: This is a remote role with periodic travel to markets for field observation and to national team locations for cross-functional planning.
    — Cross-functional engagement analysts, Market Activation Managers, Regional Field Leads, and the broader Field Marketing Strategy & Operations team.
    — Work cadence is driven by the planning calendar and playbook update cycles — with intensity peaks around major market launches, quarterly planning, and post-campaign analysis periods.

    JOB RESPONSIBILITIES


Market Archetypes & Winning Plays

  • Archetype Framework: Define and maintain T-Mobile Fiber's market archetype framework — the classification system that groups markets by their competitive, demographic, and structural conditions: fiber overlap, greenfield, T-Mobile dense, FWA migration, urban core, suburban fringe, and others as the portfolio evolves.
  • Winning Plays by Archetype: For each archetype, build and continuously refine the set of winning plays — the specific combination of campaigns, tactics, channels, audiences, and sequencing that drives maximum penetration given those market conditions.
  • Conditions of Success: Define the conditions of success for each archetype: what penetration velocity, conversion rates, and cost-per-acquisition benchmarks should look like in a market of that type at each stage of maturity.
  • Classification Logic: Establish the criteria for how a market gets classified — and the process for reclassifying markets when conditions change.

Playbook Development & Maintenance

  • Playbook Ownership: Own the T-Mobile Fiber Hyperlocal Playbook as a living document — not a static PDF. The playbook is the authoritative source of truth for how the field approaches each market type, and it must reflect current learnings, not last year's assumptions.
  • Field-Ready Standards: Build the playbook to be field-executable: clear enough that a Market Activation Manager entering a new market can use it to build their local plan without ambiguity about what to prioritize or when to trigger specific tactics.
  • Tactic-Level Guidance: Define tactic-level guidance within each winning play — D2D coverage thresholds, local event cadences, digital geo-targeting parameters, partner activation sequences — with the rationale behind each recommendation so field teams understand the logic, not just the instruction.
  • Update Cadence: Establish a regular cadence for playbook updates — incorporating performance data, field feedback, and competitive intelligence — so the playbook improves with experience rather than aging out of relevance.

Analytics Partnership & Learning Loops

  • Analyst Partnership: Partner closely with analysts to build the analytical foundation behind every playbook recommendation — identifying which tactics drive penetration in which market conditions, at what cost, and with what lag time between activation and results.
  • Learning Agenda: Design the learning questions that analytics should answer: not just 'what happened' but 'why did it happen here and not there' — pushing toward causal understanding of market performance, not just descriptive reporting.
  • Field Feedback Loops: Build feedback loops between field execution and playbook refinement — ensuring that what MAMs and Regional Field Leads observe on the ground informs the next iteration of the playbook, not just formal analytics cycles.
  • Insight Translation: Translate analytical findings into plain-language playbook updates — bridging the gap between what the data shows and what the field team needs to do differently as a result.

Field Enablement & Standards

  • Field Enablement: Enable field teams to use the playbook effectively — through training, planning support, and direct engagement with MAMs and Regional Field Leads on how to apply archetype-specific strategies to their specific markets.
  • Standards Ownership: Hold the standards for how the field plans and executes against market archetypes — reviewing local plans for alignment with playbook guidance and identifying where teams are deviating and why.
  • Deviation Analysis: Surface patterns in where the playbook isn't landing — markets where field teams consistently deviate from recommended plays — and determine whether the deviation reflects a gap in the playbook or a gap in field execution.
  • Cross-Functional SME:Serve as the subject matter expert on hyperlocal strategy in cross-functional forums — bringing a market-intelligence perspective into GTM planning, campaign development, and launch readiness conversations.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree and 7 years of related work experience. Or, a combination of education and experience deemed equivalent
  • 6+ years in marketing strategy, field marketing, or GTM strategy — with demonstrated experience building frameworks that connect market conditions to specific tactical recommendations.
  • Strong analytical orientation: comfortable working with data, partnering with analysts, and translating quantitative findings into strategic direction. Does not need to run the models — does need to know what questions to ask and what to do with the answers.
  • Proven ability to build structured frameworks and playbooks that field or sales teams actually use — not documents that get published and ignored.
  • Experience in a distributed field environment — understands the gap between strategy and execution and designs for it explicitly.
  • Strong written communication; can distill complex market strategy into clear, usable field guidance.
  • Experience in telecom, broadband, or a consumer business where local market conditions drive meaningfully different strategies across geographies preferred.
  • Background in market segmentation, audience strategy, or competitive intelligence preferred.
  • Familiarity with hyperlocal marketing tactics: door-to-door, local events, geo-targeted digital, community partnerships preferred.
  • Experience building or maintaining a living playbook or knowledge management system — not just a one-time deliverable preferred.

— At least 18 years of age

  • Legally authorized to work in the United States

Empower commercial decisions through advanced analytics and AI


You play a pivotal role in how Resmed turns complexity into clarity. As part of our Commercial Analytics team, you help Sales leaders and stakeholders make smarter, faster decisions by combining data, analytics, and AI-enabled insights to deliver measurable commercial impact.

You’ll go beyond dashboards—designing intelligent analytics products, creating predictive insights, and translating numbers into actions that improve how we reach and serve customers.

Partnering with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and IT, you’ll shape how analytics and artificial intelligence enhance commercial execution, revenue performance, and forecasting accuracy.

You’ll bring curiosity and rigor to explore emerging AI technologies, champion responsible AI practices, and advance analytics adoption across Resmed’s commercial organization. Success in this role means helping teams achieve clarity and confidence in every decision they make.

What you will do

  • Advise Sales leadership on complex commercial challenges, designing scalable analytics and AI-driven decision support solutions
  • Deliver compelling insights and recommendations that clarify performance drivers and accelerate revenue execution
  • Provide sophisticated analytics across territory planning, account prioritization, pipeline health, forecasting, and performance management
  • Design and evolve dashboards and decision tools integrated into Sales workflows to improve focus and foresight
  • Maintain high standards of analytical rigor, scalability, and data governance in every insight or product delivered
  • Lead analysis of large, multisource datasets to ensure integrity, accuracy, and actionable outcomes
  • Partner with BI and IT to optimize SQL queries, automation, and data architecture strategies
  • Apply and advance AI-enabled use cases that automate insights, improve forecasting, and increase Sales productivity
  • Prototype AI-powered workflows that simplify data access and enable faster, smarter decision-making
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies to identify and implement high-value opportunities across commercial analytics

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, or a related field; MBA preferred.
  • 5–8 years of progressive experience in sales analytics, business intelligence, commercial performance, or related analytics roles.
  • Advanced SQL skills with experience working with large, complex datasets and delivering analytics solutions using Tableau and/or Power BI.
  • Strong understanding of sales performance metrics, commercial KPIs, revenue analytics, statistical analysis, and quantitative methods.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business questions into analytical strategies, executive-ready insights, and scalable solutions from problem framing through adoption.
  • Experience applying generative AI and AI-enabled tools to automate workflows, accelerate analysis, generate insights, and support business decision-making; familiarity with prompt design and responsible AI practices preferred.
  • Familiarity with modern cloud analytics environments, including Snowflake and DBT; exposure to Python or similar analytical programming tools preferred.
  • Strong data storytelling, executive communication, and stakeholder influence skills, with the ability to drive alignment without formal authority.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple high-impact initiatives and provide analytical leadership in ambiguous environments.
  • Experience in medical devices, healthcare, regulated industries, and/or high-tech environments preferred.

What Sets You Apart

  • Analytical Thinking - You bring rigor and precision to every problem, transforming ambiguity into clear insights
  • Innovation Mindset - You experiment, prototype, and refine analytics and AI solutions with a practical sense of impact
  • Collaborative Partnership - You build strong relationships with stakeholders, driving alignment and adoption
  • Commercial Acumen - You understand revenue drivers and connect analytics to meaningful business outcomes
  • Adaptability - You thrive in evolving priorities and use data to enable agility and confidence

Why Join Resmed

At Resmed, you help millions sleep better, breathe easier, and live healthier lives. We’re transforming healthcare through technology and human insight—and data is at the heart of that mission. You’ll work with purpose-driven teams that value curiosity, innovation, and collaboration, and you’ll use your analytical and AI expertise to shape how our commercial organization performs and grows.

Benefits and Compensation
At Resmed, we're shaping the future by investing in our people through competitive pay, flexible work arrangements, and programs that support personal and professional growth.

Benefits (employees regularly scheduled to work 30+ hours per week) include:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, and disability insurance
  • HSA, FSA, commuter benefits, and sleep care management
  • 401(k), ESPP, EAP, and tuition assistance
  • Time off – Flexible Time Off (FTO)
  • 14 paid company holidays
  • Up to 14 weeks primary caregiver leave or 2 weeks secondary caregiver leave

Compensation: Compensation is based on geographic location, qualifications, experience, skills, and internal equity. For positions outside the U.S., compensation is aligned to local market conditions. Resmed generally does not hire at or near the top of the pay range.

Pay Range: 94,000.00 - 117,000.00 USD Annual
Eligible employees may have the opportunity to participate in incentive compensation programs, subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

The economic inequality crisis is one of the most defining challenges of our time. It’s also the greatest opportunity for innovation, and a challenge we’re proud to take on. At Newrich, we’re harnessing cutting-edge technology to better connect coaches with their communities and help them further spread their educational knowledge to their students and followers.

We believe that the key to making the world a better and more equal place starts with the empowering the individual. And from there- the individual can inspire and empower the people around them one by one.

We all know the old way of living and the old institutions that we all used to depend on are slowly crumbling - and a new way of life is taking it's place - at a quicker pace than ever before.

The world is changing at a very rapid pace. When all is said and done - the world will look a lot different than it looks today.

And we believe that education, inspiration, and motivation are the only way to create economic opportunity, alleviate poverty and end economic suffering for everyone.

One of the leading causes of economic inequality and suffering? It's not "being born into wealth" or " being in a special club". It's a lack of knowledge and skills to control your own financial destiny.

That’s where we come in. At Newrich, we are building the next generation creator platform and software tools to not only enable business, health, and wellness coaches to more efficiently and cost effectively run their creator business - but also to grow their audiences with improved visibility and algorithmic ranking on our social learning platform.

We empower digital entrepreneurs to turn their dreams into reality. Our mission is simple yet bold: to help people create a balanced, fulfilling lifestyle – while building wealth and independence along the way.

Our team spans the Americas and Europe, and we work with utility partners across the Americas and beyond. We’re outdoor enthusiasts, musicians, artists, athletes, parents, and adventurers—4 nationalities strong and growing. What unites us is a passion for solving complex problems, a commitment to action on economic inequality, and the belief that technology should be a force for good.

We’re a fast-growing team driven by one vision: a world where anyone can work remotely, chase their passion, and live life on their own terms.

Our platform combines SaaS tools, e-learning programs, and a supportive social network – a one-stop ecosystem designed for creators, entrepreneurs, and dreamers who want more than just a career.

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer who can contribute across the product — building new features, improving existing systems, and helping the team work more efficiently. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment and takes ownership of getting things done.

You will work across our infra stack (AWS, ECS, Fargate, RDS, S3, EC2, Lambda) contributing directly to production code while helping improve workflows, documentation, and processes. We hire for attitude and ownership over perfect technical mastery.

We believe fulfilling work and a healthy work-life balance is key to living a NewRich Lifestyle.

If you’re motivated, ambitious, and ready to grow with us, we want to hear from you!

  • Should have working knowledge of container orchestration using Kubernetes.
  • Should have knowledge of overlay networking needed for inter-container communications from different nodes.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines with Github Actions.
  • Experience automating systems deployments and configuration management using tools like Ansible, Chef, Puppet, Terraform, Saltstack.
  • Working experience with source control systems like Git.
  • Ability to work well with people from many different disciplines with varying degrees of technical experience.
  • Ability to demonstrate a clear, energetic and excited interest in automating everything (build, test, release/deploy, monitoring, reporting), which includes "Infrastructure as Code ".
  • Able to build, deploy, and host a demo web app written in the code of your choice to prove minimum general IT/DevOps proficiency.
  • Experience working as DevOps, SysOps, SRE or similar for at least 2 years.
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including CloudTrail, AWS Organizations, EC2, ECS, EKS, Elasticache, IAM, Lambda, RDS/Aurora, Route53, and S3.
  • Experienced with Docker and deploying micro services.
  • Understands how to control Cloud costs.

  • Strong working knowledge of Linux and shell scripting.
  • Ability to work remotely and effectively collaborate with distributed teams.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language such as PHP, Javascript, or Python is a plus.
  • Understanding of incident management processes and service level objectives (SLOs).
  • Ability to perform root cause analysis in AWS environments and debug micro services using Cloudwatch or related monitoring products.
  • Comfortable being part of the On-Call rotation.
  • This position will be part-time/hourly to start- with the option to go full time after 3 months.

Type: contract

About this role

If you are a biomedical engineer who thrives on technical precision, applied problem-solving, and rigorous engineering reasoning in health and life-science contexts, this is a unique opportunity to contribute directly to how the next generation of AI systems understand and communicate complex biomedical engineering concepts. We are looking for biomedical engineering specialists who can evaluate, challenge, and refine advanced language models on domain-specific topics. Your expertise as a Biomedical Engineer will directly help improve the world’s premier AI models—and play an important role in shaping the future of AI. This role is a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world’s largest AI companies and foundation-model labs.

Your profile

  • 4+ years of professional biomedical engineering experience, with significant hands-on work in one or more areas such as medical devices, biomechanics, biomaterials, tissue engineering, bioinstrumentation, imaging systems, signals & systems (physiologic), rehabilitation engineering, clinical engineering, quality/regulatory, manufacturing/validation, or a closely related specialty.

  • Deep knowledge of biomedical engineering fundamentals, such as physiology for engineers, transport phenomena in biological systems, biomechanics, materials behavior in biological environments, biosignals, sensor/measurement systems, and systems modeling (depending on specialty).

  • Strong comfort with technical assumptions, constraints, unit consistency, and defensible reasoning (including limitations, uncertainty, and safety considerations).

  • Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering (or closely related) required; Master’s/PhD or advanced credentials strongly preferred.

  • Experience with AI data training, annotation, red-teaming, or evaluating AI-generated technical content is a strong plus.

  • Familiarity with any of the following is a plus (not required): ISO 13485, IEC 60601, ISO 14971, FDA design controls (21 CFR 820), verification & validation, risk management, biocompatibility concepts (ISO 10993), or clinical workflow constraints.

Key responsibilities

  • Evaluate AI-generated responses for technical accuracy, logical soundness, completeness, and clarity across biomedical engineering topics.

  • Challenge advanced language models with realistic biomedical engineering scenarios, calculations, and design/analysis reasoning tasks.

  • Review and refine AI-generated prompts, model responses, explanations, and step-by-step solutions (including unit handling and correct interpretation of constraints).

  • Provide structured feedback that identifies factual errors, unsafe recommendations, unsupported clinical claims, missing assumptions, invalid simplifications, misuse of standards, or incomplete reasoning.

  • Assess model performance on topics such as: Biomechanics, Bioinstrumentation & sensors, Biomedical signals, Medical device design, Biomaterials, Imaging & measurement, Verification/validation & risk

  • Help shape AI communication standards for biomedical content, including how models explain assumptions, risk/limitations, what must be verified experimentally, and when to escalate to clinical/regulatory experts.

  • Ensure AI-generated content reflects responsible biomedical engineering practice—especially around patient safety, clinical claims, and regulatory-sensitive topics.

Description

🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We're looking for the person who brings a Forward Deployed Engineering curriculum to life for students: you would be part of a team of senior authors who help create the content for the course. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.

Your audience: Working production engineers, not career changers, with six to fifteen years in, mostly backend, with senior and staff engineers and the occasional engineering manager. They've shipped real software for years and are moving deliberately into forward-deployed AI work; some are already interviewing for FDE roles while they study. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client-facing half of delivery.

Format: asynchronous, estimated 20 hrs/week.

Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.

What you will do

  • Design and build the projects students work on end to end — scope, learning goals, technical infrastructure, environments, and supporting databases or datasets.
  • Write clear submission guidelines and assessment criteria (rubrics) that reviewers can apply consistently.
  • Work closely with Learning Experience Designers to make projects and lessons educationally sound and engaging: refining wording, pacing, and difficulty calibration across the course.
  • Research, evaluate, and sign off on technical solutions and tooling so the curriculum stays current and relevant to what employers actually use.
  • Contribute to sales and marketing enablement — training commercial teams on what the course covers and what graduates can do.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or technical lead on customer-facing delivery).
  • Has personally owned deployments end-to-end in real client or enterprise environments – first call through production go-live and adoption.
  • Practical experience with databases and the infrastructure needed to run student projects (cloud environments, containers, version control, CI where relevant).
  • Ability to break complex technical work into scoped, assessable tasks at a defined difficulty level.
  • Strong written communication in English — you'll produce a lot of instructional text and it needs to be unambiguous.
  • Comfort collaborating cross-functionally with instructional design, and explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience mentoring, teaching, tutoring, or reviewing others' code.

Preferred experience:

  • Prior EdTech or rubric/assessment design experience.

What we can offer you

  • Fully remote work.
  • A digital office: we use modern tools (Notion, Slack, Zoom) to keep collaboration smooth.
  • Professional trust and autonomy: no micromanaging.
  • A diverse, international, close-knit team excited to work with you!

Get to Know the Opportunity:

The Product Delivery Director is a senior business-facing leader accountable for shaping, prioritizing, and guiding the delivery of Employee Benefits technology capabilities. This role represents the business strategy and operational perspective across cross-functional delivery teams, helping ensure solutions align with business objectives, customer needs, compliance expectations, and operational efficiency goals.

The ideal candidate brings strong business product ownership, delivery management, FINEOS expertise, and stakeholder leadership experience, with the ability to translate business priorities into actionable delivery plans. This leader will influence roadmap decisions, drive prioritization, prepare business teams for change, and support successful adoption of solutions across Employee Benefits products.

This role also serves as the business product owner for claims metrics and reporting, setting the strategy and building the function as a service across operational, leadership, and external-facing reporting views. The leader translates business requirements into a comprehensive reporting suite and connects claims metrics to actionable operational outcomes in partnership with Underwriting, Pricing, and Actuarial teams.

This role is fully remote, with no regular in-office requirement.

The Contributions You’ll Make:

  • Shape the strategic roadmap for Employee Benefits technology capabilities and business solutions.
  • Partner with senior business leaders to identify opportunities that improve customer, employer, and operational experiences.
  • Establish business outcomes, success measures, KPIs, and adoption targets for technology and operational initiatives.
  • Act as the business product owner for claims metrics and reporting, defining the strategy, roadmap, and prioritized backlog to establish and scale the function as a service across all reporting views, including operational, leadership, and external-facing reports.
  • Translate business needs into requirements and acceptance criteria for a full suite of operational and external-facing reports, dashboards, and claims metrics, ensuring reporting views meet the needs of each audience.
  • Translate claims metrics and reporting insights into actionable operational outcomes and serve as the liaison to Underwriting, Pricing, and Actuarial teams to align reporting requirements, interpret results, and inform business decisions.
  • Lead prioritization of enhancements, defects, and new capabilities based on business value, customer impact, compliance needs, and operational readiness.
  • Provide business direction to ensure priorities, regulatory requirements, customer experience needs, and operational impacts are reflected in technology delivery plans.
  • Lead operational readiness planning, including identification of impacted teams, process changes, training needs, communication requirements, support impacts, and adoption risks ahead of implementation.
  • Partner with IT Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, development teams, and operations stakeholders to refine business requirements, user stories, and delivery priorities.
  • Set expectations for clear business requirements, measurable acceptance criteria, and delivery-ready documentation.
  • Represent the business in sprint planning, release planning, prioritization, and backlog management activities.
  • Resolve business-related obstacles and provide timely decision support to keep delivery teams aligned and moving forward.
  • Partner with marketing and sales enablement teams to develop internal and external communication plans before and after relevant releases.
  • Monitor delivery progress, operational and adoption readiness, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans to support successful implementation and sustained business use.
  • Oversee business testing strategies and UAT scenarios for new capabilities, enhancements, and defects.
  • Lead UAT planning, resource coordination, execution oversight, defect management, and final business sign-off activities.
  • Partner with QA teams to confirm requirements are adequately tested, validated, and ready for release.
  • Support release readiness reviews, implementation decision-making, and production deployment activities.
  • Monitor post-production outcomes and coordinate issue resolution, stabilization, and business feedback as needed.
  • Drive post-implementation adoption activities, including hypercare support, readiness checkpoints, user enablement, issue triage, and feedback collection.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and senior product delivery partner to operational leaders, product stakeholders, and technology partners.
  • Lead clear, consistent communication across product, operations, compliance, technology, and business stakeholder teams.
  • Present roadmap priorities, delivery updates, risks, decisions, and outcomes to leadership.
  • Build and sustain strong partnerships that enable execution of strategic initiatives and measurable business outcomes.

Minimum Knowledge & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • 5+ years of product delivery, product management, business analysis, or digital product leadership experience.
  • Hands-on FINEOS experience required.
  • Experience with digital portal capabilities, customer-facing applications, self-service platforms, reporting capabilities, or analytics solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience building reporting and claims metrics capabilities is required, spanning all reporting views, including operational, leadership, and external-facing reports and dashboards.
  • Proven ability to translate business requirements into a full suite of operational reports, with experience defining and delivering external-facing reports.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate claims metrics into operational outcomes and partner effectively with Underwriting, Pricing, and Actuarial teams on reporting needs, analysis, and business implications.
  • Experience operating in Agile and Scrum delivery environments as a business partner, product representative, or business product owner.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC, release management, and testing methodologies from a business delivery and stakeholder readiness perspective.
  • Demonstrated experience leading operational readiness, change adoption, training coordination, stakeholder communications, hypercare, and post-launch stabilization for business solutions.
  • Experience within Employee Benefits, Disability, Absence, Leave Management, Life, and/or Supplemental Health.

Preferred Knowledge & Experience:

  • Experience partnering with IT Product Owners and cross-functional technology teams while representing business priorities and operational needs.
  • Knowledge of reporting platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, Business Objects, or similar tools.
  • Experience supporting digital transformation, modernization, and business capability improvement initiatives.
  • Knowledge of accessibility, usability, and digital experience best practices.

How This Role Aligns to Our Core Four:

Voya’s Core Four reflect how we deliver for our customers, our business, and one another. In this role, you’ll bring them to life through thoughtful product leadership, disciplined delivery, and strong cross-functional partnership.

  • Instill Customer Obsession: Shape and prioritize Employee Benefits capabilities using customer, employer, and operational needs to improve experiences and business outcomes.
  • Transform with Automation/AI: Help advance digital capabilities and modernization by identifying opportunities to reduce friction, strengthen analysis, and improve delivery and operational efficiency through responsible automation and AI.
  • Drive Higher Performance Through Our People: Create clarity and accountability across business, product, technology, and operations partners by aligning priorities, removing obstacles, and preparing teams for successful change and adoption.
  • Execute on the Fundamentals: Strengthen delivery discipline through clear requirements, rigorous testing and UAT, regulatory and compliance consideration, release readiness, risk management, and post-launch stabilization.

raw.description:
The Research Project Manager (RPM) supports the University’s research enterprise by providing professional project management and research administration expertise for large, complex research programs and projects. The RPM applies project management methodologies and institutional processes to plan, track, analyze, and report on research activities. This role may provide ongoing project/program management support for one or more research projects and/or deliver temporary or specialized project support across multiple research projects and initiatives concurrently.

Working with a high degree of independence and receiving general direction from the Principal Investigator (PI) or designee, the RPM executes and coordinates a wide range of activities critical to research success. The RPM contributes specialized project management knowledge and institutional expertise that may fall outside the PI’s core experience, ensuring effective coordination, compliance, and operational efficiency across complex research efforts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, and manage research programs and projects using project management methodologies, tools, and institutional processes.
  • Track project progress, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and resources; analyze data and prepare clear and actionable reports for PIs and research stakeholders.
  • Serve as a central point of coordination for research activities, ensuring alignment with institutional policies, procedures, and key deadlines.
  • Collaborate directly with faculty, research teams, and administrative offices across campus on behalf of the PI and the research program or project.
  • Provide guidance and process support related to research administration, compliance, and research operations workflows.
  • Identify risks, issues, and dependencies; develop, recommend, and support implementation of mitigation strategies.
  • Support continuous improvement by identifying efficiencies, best practices, and process enhancements for effective research project execution.
  • Lead and facilitate communication among diverse stakeholders to promote clarity, accountability, and successful project outcomes.
  • Support large scale, multi institutional, or high risk research initiatives by coordinating activities across internal and external partners.
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5+ years of professional experience in project management, research administration, or a related field.
  • CAPM/PMP Certification required

Skills and Abilities:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively to diverse audiences.
  • Proven ability to interface and collaborate with faculty, staff, and administrators.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, as well as collaboratively in a team-based environment.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of project management and research administration.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.

Work Environment

The Research Project Manager works closely with faculty investigators and research teams across the University and engages regularly with administrative partners across campus. The position requires a high level of professionalism, discretion, adaptability, and independent judgment to effectively support complex, dynamic, and evolving research initiatives.

Applications due by 11/6/26

Salary up to $90,000, commensurate with experience

Moreover, Notre Dame prohibits discrimination against veterans or disabled qualified individuals, and complies with 41 CFR 60-741.5(a) and 41 CFR 60-300.5(a). We strongly encourage applications from candidates attracted to a university with a Catholic identity.

The University of Notre Dame is more than a workplace; it is a vibrant, mission-driven community where every employee is valued and supported. Rooted in a tradition of excellence and inspired by our Catholic character, Notre Dame is committed to fostering an environment of care that nurtures the whole person—mind, body, and spirit. Title:

Senior Specialist, Project Systems Delivery

KBR is seeking a Senior Specialist, Project Systems Delivery to support a portfolio of enterprise applications across engineering, government systems, supply chain, and corporate operations. This position combines technical expertise, business analysis, and stakeholder engagement to deliver scalable technology solutions that maximize business value, improve operational efficiency, and support enterprise transformation initiatives across a global organization.

Education & Experience

Technical Skills & Competencies

  • Experience working effectively across cross-functional and globally distributed teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with digital engineering, supply chain, digital delivery, or connected data environments.
  • Experience developing dashboards, KPIs, analytics, and operational reporting.
  • Experience supporting engineering, infrastructure, energy, aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or government contracting organizations.
  • Experience supporting government property, supply chain, inventory management, asset management, procurement, or logistics applications.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity, data governance, ITAR, CMMC, NIST, or similar regulatory and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience supporting cloud, SaaS, AI-enabled, or digital transformation initiatives.

Senior Informatica Developer

The Senior Informatica Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting enterprise data integration, data warehouse, and business intelligence solutions. This role partners closely with business stakeholders, analysts, architects, and application teams to deliver reliable data pipelines, optimize data processing workflows, and support reporting and analytics initiatives. The successful candidate will leverage deep expertise in Informatica, database technologies, and ETL development to build scalable data solutions while ensuring adherence to data governance, quality, and architectural standards.

Trinzic is being established as an independent public company through the planned separation of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, which is expected to be completed on January 4, 2027.   • Design, develop, enhance, and support enterprise ETL processes and data integration solutions utilizing Informatica technologies.
  • Partner with business users and IT teams to gather, analyze, and translate business requirements into technical solutions.

  • Build and support data warehouse, data mart, and business intelligence solutions designed to meet evolving business needs.
  • Perform data analysis, impact assessments, and troubleshooting activities to support development, maintenance, and enhancement projects.
  • Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, database objects, and data processing workflows to ensure performance and scalability.
  • Coordinate data development initiatives and implement new structures, interfaces, and processes to improve data accessibility and efficiency.
  • Support data governance initiatives by ensuring compliance with established standards, policies, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support releases, deployments, testing activities, and change management processes.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to less experienced team members and contribute to continuous improvement efforts across the data engineering function.

Basic Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related discipline; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Minimum seven (7) years of experience developing ETL and data integration solutions using Informatica PowerCenter.
  • Minimum five (5) years of experience using Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) Data Integration.
  • Experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise data warehouse and business intelligence solutions.
  • Experience working with Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases in enterprise environments.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.

Technical Expertise

  • Strong understanding of data analysis, data modeling, database design, and relational database concepts.
  • Experience developing ETL workflows, mappings, transformations, and integrations using Informatica technologies.
  • Experience loading and transforming data from multiple data sources into enterprise data warehouses and analytical environments.
  • Experience with Oracle database technologies, including indexing, stored procedures, materialized views, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server databases and advanced SQL development.
  • Experience performing SQL tuning, performance optimization, and data validation activities.
  • Experience utilizing metadata, impact analysis, and data governance methodologies.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results independently.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience mentoring team members and contributing to collaborative project delivery.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Informatica IDMC Web Services and command line utilities.
  • Experience loading and integrating Excel-based data sources into enterprise databases using Informatica IDMC.
  • Experience with enterprise job scheduling and workload automation tools.
  • Experience with SQL development tools such as Toad or SQL Developer.
  • Experience with Python and/or PowerShell scripting.
  • Experience supporting cloud-based data integration and modernization initiatives.

Sitting at the intersection of UX, product strategy, and platform architecture, this leader will influence not only how our products look and feel, but how they are built, scaled, and evolve over time. They will reimagine how users work across the platform by identifying opportunities to simplify complexity, rethink legacy workflows, and design human-in-the-loop moments that combine human judgment with AI-driven efficiency and intelligence.

  • Lead platform UX strategy: Define and drive the long-term user experience vision across the Workiva Platform, aligning design direction with product strategy, platform architecture, and business goals.
  • Shape AI experiences: Lead the charge in envisioning AI-powered experiences, including generative interfaces, intelligent automation, recommendations, and decision-support workflows.
  • Reimagine workflows: Rethink and redesign existing workflows to create simpler, faster, and more intuitive experiences across complex enterprise use cases.
  • Design human-in-the-loop moments: Determine where human oversight, review, escalation, and decision-making should remain central in AI-enabled workflows, and design those interaction points with clarity and trust.
  • Solve complex system challenges: Lead discovery across ambiguous, cross-functional problems by combining research, product insight, data, and technical constraints into scalable solutions.
  • Drive experience architecture: Establish reusable patterns, interaction models, and information architecture that scale across a multi-product ecosystem.
  • Influence technical direction: Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to shape platform direction, service design, data flows, and implementation choices that affect user experience.
  • Advance design systems and governance: Guide the evolution of design systems to support consistency, flexibility, and innovation at scale.
  • Mentor senior talent: Coach Lead and Senior Designers, raise craft standards, and strengthen design culture across the organization.

What You’ll Need

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in product design, UX, or related fields, with significant work on platform or enterprise products.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, HCI, or a related field (or 8 years of experience and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 6 years of experience).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Track record of delivering 0→1 products and scaling them in market
  • Proven experience influencing product strategy, experience direction, and technical decision-making.
  • Experience establishing UX best practices for emerging technologies or ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Proven track record of driving innovation in user interface design through experimentation, new tools and processes, and close collaboration with design, engineering, data science, and research partners.
  • Experience with AI/ML and agentic technologies; depth and breadth of knowledge that enables ideation and development of creative solutions.
  • Deep expertise in user-centered design methodologies applied to enterprise workflows.
  • Experience designing AI-powered product experiences and human-in-the-loop workflows.
  • Experience leveraging AI within the design process for discovery, prototyping, and synthesis.
  • Strong technical fluency across platform ecosystems, APIs, and design systems.
  • Experience working in large-scale Agile environments.

Travel & Work Environment

  • Up to 25% travel.
  • Remote work requires reliable high-speed internet.

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

raw.description:
Our work at NVIDIA is dedicated towards a computing model focused on visual and AI computing. For two decades, NVIDIA has pioneered visual computing, the art and science of computer graphics, with our invention of the GPU. The GPU has also shown to be spectacularly effective at solving some of the most complex problems in computer science. Today, NVIDIA’s GPU simulates human intelligence, running deep learning algorithms and acting as the brain of computers, robots and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. We are looking to grow our company and teams with the smartest people in the world and there has never been a more exciting time to join our team!


NVIDIA Architecture Modeling group is looking for Architects, Functional Modeling Engineers, and Simulation experts to join various architecture efforts across GPU Architecture teams. In this position, you will be working with other world-class architects on enabling functional simulation platforms across GPU generations.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Modeling of GPU architecture, baseboard components and other features
  • Work in a matrixed environment, across the different modeling teams, to document, design, develop tools to analyze and simulate, validate and verify models
  • Familiarize with different functional and performance simulation models across Nvidia and work through modeling features
  • Develop tests, test plans and testing infrastructure for new architectures/ features
  • Guide the improvement of the simulation platform and expand other resources to support future GPU architectures
  • Develop or use AI to help with day-to-day tasks

What we need to see:

  • BS, MS, PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field with 5+ years of experience in related areas
  • Proficient programming skills in C++, C, and scripting languages such as Python or Perl.
  • Solid background in Computer Architecture with experience in modeling (System C & TLM preferred)
  • Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, and LangChain
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with a track record of driving issues to closure
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work successfully in a distributed team environment
  • Strong collaboration skills with design and engineering teams

#ArchitectYourFuture
