raw.description:
Job Summary:


  • The Technology FinOps Lead is responsible for establishing and leading an integrated financial management capability for CDW Technology, providing leaders with clear, consistent, and actionable visibility into Technology spend, consumption, capacity, and value.
  • This role brings together existing software vendor management and sourcing responsibilities with financial management of contract labor, cloud consumption, AI consumption, managed services, global delivery resources, capitalization, and Technology investments. The role will improve the predictability and transparency of Technology costs while simplifying, standardizing, and improving the underlying financial processes used to plan, track, allocate, forecast, and manage those costs.
  • The FinOps Lead will partner closely with Technology leadership, Finance, Strategic Sourcing, engineering and infrastructure teams, and program leaders to understand what Technology is spending, why it is being spent, how that spend aligns with priorities, and where opportunities exist to optimize cost and improve value.

What you will do:


  • Assess current Technology financial processes and identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and strengthen controls.
  • Design and implement scalable processes for budgeting, forecasting, time reporting, software and vendor spend, contract labor, capitalization, cost allocation, cloud consumption, AI consumption, and management reporting.
  • Map current-state processes, identify gaps and failure points, and establish clear future-state workflows, ownership, decision rights, and controls.
  • Reduce reliance on manual reconciliations, disconnected spreadsheets, inconsistent definitions, and one-off reporting processes.
  • Establish common financial taxonomies and definitions so Technology and Finance have a consistent view of costs, commitments, forecasts, and variances.
  • Improve the flow and reconciliation of information between Technology operational processes and financial systems.
  • Develop repeatable monthly and quarterly operating rhythms for reviewing forecasts, spend, commitments, risks, and opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and financial processes using available data, analytics, and workflow capabilities.
  • Establish process documentation, metrics, and controls that improve data quality, timeliness, consistency, and accountability.
  • Lead cross-functional improvement initiatives requiring coordination across Technology, Finance, Strategic Sourcing, vendors, and delivery teams.
  • Measure whether redesigned processes are delivering tangible improvements in forecast predictability, reporting cycle time, data quality, financial visibility, cost control, and decision-making.

What we expect of you:


  • Bachelor’s degree and 7 years of experience in management consulting, corporate finance, strategic finance, finance transformation, or technology financial management, with experience solving complex business and financial problems and 1 year of people management experience, OR 11 years of experience in management consulting, corporate finance, strategic finance, finance transformation, or technology financial management, with experience solving complex business and financial problems and 1 year of people management experience.
  • Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, cost management, and management reporting.
  • Demonstrated experience using structured problem-solving and process-improvement methods to assess current-state processes, identify root causes, design future-state solutions, and implement sustainable improvements.
  • Experience developing and implementing operating models, processes, governance, controls, and reporting frameworks across complex organizations.
  • Ability to analyze complex financial and operational data and translate findings into clear recommendations and decisions for senior leaders.
  • Experience developing business cases, scenario analyses, cost-benefit analyses, and executive-level financial reporting.
  • Ability to connect financial information with operational drivers such as workforce capacity, technology consumption, vendor commitments, project activity, and business priorities.
  • Strong financial and analytical capabilities, including advanced proficiency with Excel and experience with financial reporting, data analysis, and visualization.
  • Demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguous problems, challenge existing processes, and drive cross-functional change from problem identification through implementation.
  • Ability to partner effectively across Technology, Finance, Strategic Sourcing/Procurement, vendors, and business leadership.
  • Strong executive communication and presentation skills, including the ability to simplify complex financial and operational issues into actionable insights.
  • Experience in management consulting, finance transformation, technology strategy, or Technology/IT finance, a plus.
  • Experience applying methodologies such as process mapping, root-cause analysis, Lean, continuous improvement, or similar structured improvement approaches, a plus
  • Experience working with significant Technology cost categories such as software, contract labor, cloud, managed services, or consumption-based technology services, a plus.
  • Familiarity with FinOps, Technology Business Management (TBM), or IT financial management concepts, a plus.
  • Exposure to technology sourcing, vendor management, contract negotiations, or software portfolio management, a plus.
  • Experience with Technology capitalization, labor allocation, project financial management, or time-reporting processes, a plus.
  • Experience with financial, analytical, or reporting platforms such as Power BI, Workday, Apptio/TBM solutions, or cloud cost-management tools, a plus.
  • FinOps Foundation, finance, accounting, Lean/Six Sigma, or related professional certification is a plus but not required, a plus.

Pay range: $114,000 - $158,000 depending on experience and skill set

Annual bonus target of 10%, subject to terms and conditions of plan

Benefits overview:

Salary ranges may be subject to geographic differentials

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization

As a leader, you will champion and be accountable for our vision of becoming an AI-fluent organization. We expect leaders to model curiosity, encourage responsible AI adoption, and foster a culture of continuous learning. You don’t need deep technical expertise, but you should be comfortable exploring how AI can enhance strategy, decision-making, and team performance. Your role includes guiding others in building confidence and capability with AI tools and practices, while promoting openness to experimentation and shared learning.

Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

About Us

CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.

As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.

Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do. Together, we Make Amazing Happen.

About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

Role Purpose:


We build technology that protects temperature-sensitive goods as they move through the global supply chain. We are looking for a Digital Product Design Researcher who can move fluidly from user insight to product execution, making complex, high-stakes operational workflows legible and turning regulated, jargon-heavy reality into intuitive, testable product experiences. The right candidate will study real-world temperature-sensitive supply chain environments, observe how users work and make decisions, and translate those insights into user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and design recommendations that improve customer outcomes.

Working with stakeholders, product owners, and designers, this role will uncover behavioral insights across audiences and ensure our digital products reflect users’ lived experiences. The work spans innovation, digital, and design initiatives critical to Carrier’s growth, from new opportunities to designs in varying stages of development.

  • Communicate research findings and implications to internal teams and partners with clarity
  • Design user-centered components and experience patterns that align with established design systems and accessibility standards.
  • Partner closely with stakeholders, product owners, developers, and designers to ensure research-backed designs balance user needs, business priorities, and implementation constraints
  • Contribute to the growth and development of the Carrier Digital’s Design Research craft

raw.description:
Convergent Research is a non-profit science studio best known for pioneering the Focused Research Organization (FRO): a startup-style team built to tackle one ambitious scientific problem that academia and industry can’t. We’re launching moonshot science projects which may change the trajectory of scientific progress. Today we support 14 FROs and counting across the US, the UK and Chile, with an annual budget of $75 million and growing. Large-scale brain mapping, climate measurement and software for math all have something in common: they each need a nonprofit legal entity, payroll providers, health benefits, boards, contracts, office space, press releases, websites… For every FRO we support, Convergent provides the backend infrastructure that lets them move fast.

About the Role

As the Controller, you oversee the full accounting operation across Convergent, its disregarded entities and its subsidiaries, from the general ledger and monthly close to internal controls, audit and regulatory compliance. You will also build and run our federal grants program: designing the compliance infrastructure, monitoring every award, and executing against 2 CFR Part 200 from award setup to closeout. Reporting to the Head of Finance, you will lead a team of Finance & Accounting Managers and serve as our in-house expert on GAAP and federal grant compliance, weighing in on matters of significance with team, FRO and Convergent leaders.

This is a fully remote position with domestic travel required quarterly for team and organizational onsites, and as needed.

You Are

  • A seasoned nonprofit accountant. You bring deep, hands-on experience across the full accounting cycle in nonprofits, including fund accounting, net asset restrictions, multi-entity consolidation, and revenue recognition for contributions, grants and exchange transactions. You enjoy solving complex reconciliation challenges and have a passion for financial accuracy.

  • The in-house GAAP expert. You support the Head of Finance in researching and documenting technical accounting positions, such as conditional grants, restricted gifts, leases and intercompany transactions, and leaders rely on your judgment on matters of significance.

  • Audit-seasoned. You have participated in more audits and single audits than you can count and have filed just as many 990s. You know what the auditors will ask before they ask it.

  • A federal grants program builder. You know all the components of 2 CFR Part 200. You have built federal grant compliance programs from the ground up: written the policies, procedures and control documentation, stood up the systems, and audited them yourself. You are comfortable across agencies and award types, including grants, cooperative agreements and other transactions.

  • A people leader. You have led accounting teams, including managers. You set clear standards, review work closely and help your team grow.

  • Pleasantly detail-obsessed. You sweat the details, but don’t get hung up on immaterial ones. You know when it’s appropriate to push back for compliance or GAAP sake.

  • Systems-savvy. You enjoy working with multiple systems and have a firm grasp of accounting systems. You know when to ask for systems help too!

  • A natural collaborator. You can translate a complex journal entry into plain English for a non-finance colleague without breaking a sweat.

You Will

  • Own the close. You oversee monthly reconciliation and close across Convergent, its disregarded entities and its subsidiaries, including consolidation and intercompany. You set the close calendar and review standards, and you know the ins and outs of every detail on those balance sheets.

  • Lead the accounting team. Manage and develop a team of Finance & Accounting Managers. Set priorities, review their work, and design metrics to measure performance and team successes.

  • Build the federal grants program. Design and implement Convergent’s federal grants compliance program under 2 CFR Part 200, including policies and procedures, internal controls, allowable cost review, time and effort reporting, cost allocation, indirect and fringe rate support, and subrecipient monitoring.

  • Oversee every award. Make sure the Finance & Accounting Managers manage each federal award across Convergent and its FROs correctly from award setup through closeout. Review their budget-to-actuals, burn rates, cost share, drawdowns and invoicing, federal financial reports, SEFA and procurement documentation such as debarment checks and sole-source justifications, and step in early when risks or errors surface.

  • Own audit readiness. Lead preparation for the annual audit and the Single Audit, including PBC requests, supporting schedules, SEFA and corrective action plans, coordinate 990 workpapers with our preparer, and own regulatory financial reporting.

  • Own revenue and restrictions. Make sure revenue recognition, donor restriction tracking and releases, payroll allocations and time and effort reporting are accurate across every entity.

  • Turn numbers into insight. As first line reviewer of monthly financial reports, you review monthly financials for relevancy, consistency, and completeness, and advocate for changes that make reports useful for decision-making.

  • Strengthen systems and controls. Write and maintain accounting SOPs and internal control documentation, improve workflows and systems, and keep controls tight across every entity.

  • Lead the in-house transition. Partner with the Head of Finance to move work from our outsourced accounting firm in-house, mapping each task to an owner and keeping the close on track during the handoff.

  • Partner on budgets and policy. Support the Head of Finance on the annual budget, financial policies and internal control design, and serve as backup on chart of accounts changes.

  • Bring the whole team along. You make financial insights accessible and actionable, whether you're talking to a scientist, an engineer, or a program lead.

In 6 months you will have (6 months goals)

  • Learned the business of each FRO and understood its accounting and grant needs.

  • Built strong relationships with your team, internal teams, FRO leaders, auditors and external accounting partners.

  • Assessed our federal grants compliance against 2 CFR Part 200, delivered a roadmap, and put the priority policies and controls in place.

  • Set up award-level monitoring for every active federal award.

  • Brought the monthly close onto a consistent calendar with clear review standards across your team.

We Offer (Amazing Benefits)

  • A rare chance to build institutional architecture for frontier science and work with some of the smartest and most talented experts from different fields

  • Competitive Salary: $176,000. Convergent uses a consistent compensation philosophy across all roles, and we offer a 5-10% premium for those working from especially high cost of labor locations (e.g. NYC, San Francisco) or from our NYC office. This structure helps us keep pay transparent, consistent, and equitable.

  • Up to a 6% 401k match because future-you deserves comfort

  • Top-tier medical, dental, and vision insurance—majority of options are fully covered for you and your dependents. Stay healthy, my friend

  • Company-paid life insurance, AD&D, long- and short-term disability insurance, as well as voluntary supplemental insurance options

  • 19 holidays (including a full week off at the end of the year—yes, we enforce it)

  • 3 weeks PTO with tenure increases, with separate allotments for sick and parental leave

  • Generous fertility benefits and childcare reimbursement—because tiny humans are a big deal

  • Education and professional development benefits

  • Wellness allowance for fitness and wellness activities (treat yourself to climbing shoes or Calm.com—no judgment)

  • 3x/year offsite team retreats and additional opportunities to meet your teammates in person

Convergent Research aims to help fill a structural gap in today's R&D system. We enable fundamental research that requires unusual levels of scale and coordination yet is not rapidly monetizable by industry. We’re bringing together top talent from academia, industry, and startups to build a new model for innovative R&D.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We believe in hiring individuals based on their unique talents—not on race, color, religion, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law or our company policies. We are more than a proud Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Our goal is to foster a healthy, safe, and respectful environment where all employees are valued and treated with dignity. Harassment of any kind is not tolerated here.

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage a high-volume portfolio of B2B accounts, specifically focusing on proactive monitoring and initial outreach for lower-tier past-due accounts.

  • Contact customers via email and phone regarding overdue invoices while maintaining a professional and helpful demeanor.

  • Utilize knowledge of payment cycles and customer behavior to assist in cash forecasting and provide predictability on expected weekly/monthly collections.

  • Embrace an AI-friendly mindset and demonstrate a willingness to learn quickly and successfully integrate new automation tools into daily workflows.

  • Monitor aging reports and provide regular updates to Finance Leadership on collection status and potential bad debt risks.

  • Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or customer issues that may be delaying payment by collaborating closely with Sales, Renewals, and Operations.

  • Ensure all collection activities and customer interactions are accurately recorded in the ERP/CRM systems (NetSuite, Salesforce).

  • Post daily customer payments by recording cash, checks, and credit card transactions.

  • Use basic knowledge of contracts to understand customer payment terms and identify any account inconsistencies.

  • Effectively communicate with the Sales, Operations, and Finance teams.

  • Participating in Governance calls and handling ad hoc projects as assigned

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting/finance or related field.

  • 1-2 years’ experience in accounts receivable and collections can substitute for educational requirements.

  • Basic knowledge of sales contracts and standard payment terms.

  • Flexibility to work an early shift schedule to provide coverage and support for European time zones.

  • Intermediate to Advanced Excel skills.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, verbal and written communications, and interpersonal skills.

  • Self-motivated with the ability to multi-task and work in a dynamic fast-paced environment.

  • Knowledge and experience with automation tools and processes would be an added advantage.

  • Flexibility and adaptability navigate frequent changes in a fast-growing company

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
This role is remote in the country of Mexico. You must be located in and authorized to work in Mexico to be considered for this role.

Language:

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud®?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.
One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.
JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at with the subject line "Scam Notice"

raw.description:
Reed in Partnership has been delivering public services since 1998. We are a British, family-owned company, whose mission has always been to positively transform people and their communities. This is reflected in our services, which we deliver to help people from all backgrounds and circumstances to change their lives for the better.

Pay Range

£40,000 to £55,000

Working Hours/Pattern:

Full-time, although we would be happy to consider applicants who are looking to work on a part time basis. If you would like to explore this further please discuss this with the talent partner for this role. Please note our ability to accommodate flexible working arrangements will vary from role to role, dependent on business requirements.

Job Description

Do you have experience of establishing, developing and managing a network of training providers?


Do you have proven experience of monitoring provider performance, quality standards and contractual compliance?

Then consider the role of Training Network Manager at Reed in Partnership!

Please Note, these roles are expressions of interest only at this point. We are currently working on a number of exciting opportunities within this area and are looking to build a pipeline of talent to allow us to work quickly upon contract award. We will be in a position to be able to begin the formal recruitment process in the coming weeks and we will be in touch to discuss the next steps of your expression of interest as soon as possible.

Internal applications for this role close on 06/10/2026

What is the role about?

North Sea Jobs Service (NSJS) is a voluntary transition service for current and former UK-resident oil gas workers who have worked in the industry within the last 2 years. It is commissioned by the UK Government, specifically the Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (DESNZ). Workers can access up to 12 months of tailored support, with the primary aim to create employment opportunities through employer and trade union engagement and provide Workers with tailored employment support and training.


The Training Network Manager will establish and manage a network of approved training providers, ensuring provision is aligned to identified skills gaps and employer demand. They will lead on the design and implementation of quality assurance frameworks, including audits, performance monitoring, and compliance checks. The role will oversee the development of SLAs and performance expectations with a network of training providers, ensuring consistency of delivery standards. They will analyse Worker feedback and outcome data to drive continuous improvement and work closely with employer engagement and delivery teams to ensure training provision is responsive, relevant, and outcome focused.


They will lead and manage a small team of Training Network Executives.


Please note, the Training Network Manager may be required to travel around the UK when needed, including to Aberdeen where we will have an NSJS office.

Just some of your day-to-day responsibilities will include:


  • Establishes, develops and manages a network of training providers.
  • Liaise with Team Leaders and local operational teams to assess needs of our Worker caseload, identifying any gaps in existing provision.
  • Continually map provision and service gaps, quickly implementing additional or alternative provision in response to any changes in services e.g. removal or changes to local services.
  • Represents Reed in Partnership at external meetings, identifying opportunities to influence the design and approach of such initiatives / new opportunities.
  • Work with training provisions to identify ways in which they might structure training to provide greater accessibility to NSJS workers and meet employer needs.
  • Design, implement and maintain quality assurance frameworks across all training providers.
  • Complete regular audits, compliance reviews and performance assessments to ensure providers meet agreed standards.
  • Monitor training performance against contractual KPIs and quality standards.
  • Analyse management information and performance data to identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement.
  • Mentoring new and experienced staff, coaching for performance and instruction as required.

What’s in it for you?

A generous base salary (pro-rata for part time), and great flexibility with your working schedule, we offer training, development and progression opportunities. You will have access to the range of Reed in Partnership benefits, which include:

  • 25 days annual leave (pro-rata for part time) plus statutory bank holidays
  • Reed Pension Scheme
  • Award Winning Management & Leadership training
  • Professional & Personal Development Funds
  • Bi-annual pay reviews
  • Plus much more that can be found on our website
  • With the chance to dramatically make a difference to the local community, this role offers immense job satisfaction.

At Reed in Partnership, we live and breathe our values in every decision and action taken, resulting in a collaborative and enjoyable culture within our offices. Our company values – we are fair open and honest; we take ownership, and we work together.

To be successful in this role, we are looking for someone with:

  • BPSS (Baseline Personnel Security Standard)
  • Experience of sales management including the supervision of an individuals'/teams’ delivery and/or output.
  • A personal track record of working towards and achieving targets.
  • Experience of people management including supporting, mentoring and coaching and developing an individual.
  • A minimum of 2 A-Levels or an equivalent Level 3 Diploma.
  • GCSE English Language at a minimum of a Grade B (or equivalent Level 2 qualification). OR achievement of a Level 2 in Literacy Assessment at interview stage.

Essential Criteria

  • Training Network Manager attributes include; Judgement and Decision Making, Relationship and Stakeholder Management, Sales and Performance Management, Inspiring and Influencing, Problem Resolution, Support and Advice, Growth and Development, Approach to Quality, Professionalism and Integrity, Assertiveness and Resilience and Flexibility and Creativity.
  • Technical skills including; strong administration skills, good computer/technology skills, basic numeracy/spreadsheet skills, quality assurance/audits, and good written communication/record keeping skills.
  • Personal interests including interest in people and willingness to learn.

Desirable Criteria

  • Experience of working in the employment support, skills or employability sectors
  • Experience of working in a fast-paced performance target driven environment, such experience may include working within relevant sectors/fields.
  • Experience of managing a business-to-business sales process.
  • Knowledge of the Clean Energy, Oil and Gas and Industry Priority Sectors (e.g. Advanced Manufacturing, Construction, Life Sciences etc).

We aim to ensure that no candidate or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief, age, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity. We offer a guaranteed interview scheme for disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria.

The selected candidate will also contribute to cross-functional business initiatives, particularly in campaign and tooling rollouts for Marketing. Experience with Skill-Based Dialling (SBD) and Outbound Campaign Management in Genesys Cloud will be important for this role

Language Requirements: Fluency in both Spanish and English is required.

Responsibilities

  • Designing, configuring, and deploying IVR flows in Genesys Cloud Architect, including routing logic, customer identification and authentication, and pre-operator stages.
  • Leading the development and integration of the WhatsApp Business channel within Genesys Cloud, including templates, digital routing, and Business-Scoped User ID (BSUID) management.
  • Configuring and optimizing Outbound and Skill Based Dialling campaigns, including Fair Use compliance, dialling ratios, and agent-to-skill assignment.
  • Acting as a technical reference for Marketing rollout initiatives, including campaign assignment, predictive and progressive dialling, contact list management, and contactability.
  • Contributing to the evolution of Genesys Cloud integration architecture with internal applications using the Embeddable Framework, EventBridge, and APIs.
  • Providing functional and technical support for incidents and requests related to IVR, WhatsApp, and Outbound functionality.
  • Documenting solution designs, flows, and configurations and preparing technical deliverables, including manuals, diagrams, and test cases, in English and Spanish.
  • Defining and applying best practices, configuration standards, and test plans for new platform developments.
  • Collaborating with Genesys, system integrators, and other vendors on incident resolution and the evaluation of new platform features.
  • Working closely with Marketing, Operations, Development, and Platform teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • 6+ years of hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud CX in high-volume contact center environments.
  • Strong experience developing and configuring IVR flows with Genesys Cloud Architect; experience with Composer/ININ in Genesys OnPrem is also relevant.
  • Hands-on experience integrating WhatsApp Business API with contact center platforms.
  • Demonstrable expertise in Skill Based Dialling (SBD) and Outbound campaign management in Genesys Cloud, including Fair Use, dialling ratios, DNC lists, and contactability.
  • Hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud REST APIs, Data Actions, and webhooks for third-party and internal system integrations.
  • Experience with digital channels, including chat and SMS, and digital routing/ACD configuration.
  • English B2+ and Spanish C1+ proficiency.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Speech and Text Analytics and contactability dashboards.
  • Knowledge of telephony regulatory frameworks, including STIR/SHAKEN, Ley SAC, and prefix regulations, as applied to IVR and Outbound solutions.
  • Official Genesys Cloud certifications, such as Genesys Cloud Certified Professional.
  • Experience with Genesys OnPrem to Genesys Cloud migration projects.
  • Knowledge of conversational AI or AIOps solutions for IVR and voicebots, such as ElevenLabs or similar platforms.
  • Experience working with large-scale contact centers in the security, alarms, or subscription services sectors.

We offer:

  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

*Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Title:

GNC Engineer - Remote

At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 85 countries and operations in over 28 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results.


Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions. 


Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact. 


Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment. 


Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!

Around here, we define the future.

We are a company of innovators, thinkers, creators, explorers, volunteers, and dreamers. But we all share one goal: to improve the world responsibly and safely.

THIS POSITION IS CONTINGENT UPON CONTRACT AWARD

Position Summary- Remote

We are seeking a GNC Engineer to support the design, development, testing, and real-time operation of advanced aerospace systems. This role bridges engineering development and flight/operational execution, requiring strong technical depth, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to translate complex system behavior into actionable decisions.

The ideal candidate brings experience across flight dynamics, control systems, software interaction, and operational environments.

This is a remote position with limited, business-need driven travel to onsite locations.

Key Responsibilities

  • GNC System Development & Integration
    • Support design, analysis, and verification of guidance, navigation, and control algorithms and architecture
    • Review and guide flight software design to improve system performance, robustness, and operability
    • Evaluate system behavior across full mission phases (e.g., ascent, on-orbit, entry, proximity operations)
  • Operational Readiness & Real-Time Support
    • Develop and execute operational concepts for GNC systems in mission or test environments
    • Monitor vehicle performance and make time-critical recommendations during dynamic operations
    • Support anomaly resolution, fault response strategies, and contingency planning
  • Requirements, Tools & Procedures
    • Define system and console requirements for monitoring and commanding GNC subsystems
    • Develop operator displays, telemetry utilization strategies, and command interfaces
    • Maintain flight rules, procedures, and operational documentation
  • Testing & Validation
    • Support system-level testing (integrated labs, simulations, hardware-in-the-loop environments)
    • Participate in verification of telemetry, command pathways, and system responses
    • Contribute to development and validation of contingency commanding capabilities

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in aerospace engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field (advanced degree preferred) and 10+ years of experience
  • Strong foundation in:
    • Orbital mechanics / astrodynamics
    • Control systems and state estimation
    • Guidance algorithms and vehicle dynamics
  • Experience working with:
    • Flight software or embedded systems
    • Real-time or near-real-time operational environments
    • Telemetry analysis and command/response systems
  • Demonstrated ability to:
    • Operate effectively under pressure and make timely, sound decisions
    • Communicate complex technical issues clearly and concisely
    • Work across multidisciplinary teams
  • Must be a U.S Citizen

Preferred Qualifications

  • TS/SCI Clearance
  • Experience supporting mission operations or system operations in a control center or similar environment
  • Background in anomaly resolution, fault detection/isolation/recovery (FDIR), and contingency operations
  • Familiarity with simulation environments, integrated test labs, or hardware/software validation
  • Experience developing procedures, flight rules, or operator tools
  • Prior experience training or certifying personnel in technical or operational roles

What Sets a Strong Candidate Apart

  • Demonstrated ownership of end-to-end GNC capabilities (not just analysis, but how the system is used)
  • Ability to connect engineering design decisions to real-world operational impacts
  • Proven performance in high-stakes, time-critical environments
  • Strong judgment, accountability, and credibility with both engineers and operators
  • Comfort operating in “gray space” where processes aren’t fully defined

Basic Compensation:

Jobs on this contract range from $133,900 - $200,800.

The offered rate will be based on the position, contract affordability, the selected candidate’s working location, knowledge, skills, abilities, experience, and in consideration of internal parity.

 Additional Compensation:

  • KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short-term incentives, long-term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.


Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. raw.title: Director, People Partnership
raw.excerpt: Summary:The Director of People Partnership (PP) guides organizational impact across the ASPCA with consistent processes, policies, and leadership that value our people, and support our mission, and keep staff engaged.
raw.description:
Summary:

The Director of People Partnership (PP) guides organizational impact across the ASPCA with consistent processes, policies, and leadership that value our people, and support our mission, and keep staff engaged. With engaged and committed staff, we can move towards our overall vision that animals live good lives: where they are valued by society, protected by its laws, and free from cruelty, pain, and suffering.

Who We Are

Our People ARE the ASPCA. The People Team (HR) at the ASPCA enables the organization to thrive by empowering and valuing every team member and providing an exceptional workplace across our varied disciplines. To make the greatest impact on animals, we must support the people who do the work, so our staff feel investment from the organization and can effectively prioritize and engage with our mission, work together, and develop necessary skills and capabilities, so we can successfully serve the ASPCA’s guiding vision that the United States is a humane community in which all animals are treated with respect and kindness.

What You’ll Do


By partnering directly with Department Heads, People Managers, and Individual Contributors, the Director, People Partnership will create meaningful opportunities for all staff to learn and grow. The Director will partner with internal client teams to maximize the contributions of each employee through engagement and career development opportunities.

This person will advise all levels of staff and needs to understand how to shift their approach accordingly while exercising exceptional judgment and discretion. In addition, the Director will work with other parts of the People Team, Legal Department, and Internal Communications to provide a cross-functional experience for the teams they support. This person needs to bring a neutral mindset with practical management experience to help drive overall strategy and facilitate challenging conversations to enable staff to complete their work effectively and efficiently. This will enable the Director to make connections across the organization to drive the ASPCA’s long-term goals forward.

  • Director, People Partnership, reports directly to the Senior Director, People Partnership and has no direct reports.

Where and When You’ll Work

  • This remote-based position (which requires travel, as described below) is open to all eligible candidates based within the United States
  • Must be willing to support work across multiple time zones, especially in the Eastern Time Zone
  • Two weekend on-call shifts a quarter
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 20% annually, as needed

What You’ll Get

Compensation

The target hiring range is based on where the employee works, which for remote roles is the employee’s primary location of residence, and its respective cost of labor. You can view which zone applies to you based on your location (aspca.app.box.com/v/aspcazonetable). For questions regarding locations not on the list, please send an email to for more information.

Starting pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of factors, including but not limited to education, training, experience, location, business needs, internal equity, market demands or budgeted amount for the role. The target hiring range is for new hire offers only, and compensation may increase beyond the maximum hiring range based on performance over time. The maximum of the hiring range is reserved for candidates with the highest qualifications and relevant experience. The expected hiring salary ranges for this role are set forth below and may be modified in the future.


  • Zone 1: $98,000 - $105,000
  • Zone 2: $109,000 - $116,000
  • Zone 3: $119,000 - $127,000

Benefits

At the ASPCA, you don’t have to choose between your passion and making a living. Our comprehensive benefits package helps ensure you can live a rewarding life at work and at home. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Affordable health coverage, including medical, employer-paid dental, and optional vision coverage.
  • Flexible time off that includes vacation time, sick and bereavement time, paid parental leave, 10 company paid holidays, and paid personal time off that allows you even more flexibility to observe the days that mean the most to you.
  • Competitive financial incentives and retirement savings including a 401(k) plan with generous employer contributions — we match dollar for dollar up to 4% and provide an additional 4% contribution toward your future each year.
  • Robust professional development opportunities including classes, on-the-job training, coaching and mentorship with industry-leading peers, internal mobility, opportunities to support in the field, and so much more.

Responsibilities:

What You’ll Do

People Partner Support to Client Teams


  • Maintain and manage a client portfolio across the ASPCA by establishing and building trusting and professional partnerships among all levels of staff
  • Partner with direct manager to align support for shared teams and optimize outcomes for the ASPCA, teams, and employees.
  • Synthesize team challenges with People Partnership colleagues and other stakeholders across the People Team as appropriate to inform senior leaders and support strategic decision-making.
  • Regularly partner with internal team leadership (Department Heads and People Managers) to leverage strengths, anticipate challenges, and proactively identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness and remove potential roadblocks to further our mission and effectively use our resources
  • Partner with the manager to advance priorities, taking ownership of delegated work and driving assignments through completion.
  • Focus on the highest‑impact drivers of the employee experience, including behavior aligned with our Core Values, goal‑setting, high-quality feedback, manager capability, interpersonal guidance, and people decision‑making, while also reinforcing organizational policies and procedures that strengthen engagement, retention and successful offboarding
  • Lead inquiries, consultations, and formal investigations on grievances and complaints related to confidential matters, recommending an outcome with the Legal Team and following through on the outcome as determined by the manager
  • Create talking points and guide critical conversations between manager and employee to ensure the right message is delivered and employment policies are followed
  • Consult with departments on workforce planning, including headcount strategy, budget planning, and evaluation of proposed restructures and team changesManage conversations with employees on both sides of an issue, while remaining neutral but direct, keeping in mind the best outcome for the ASPCA
  • Mediate solution-based conversations around conflicts based on direct communication and our Behavioral Competencies and Core Values
  • Facilitate workshops and other trainings the ASPCA offers across the organization, in partnership with Learning and Development
  • Attend client team meetings for an in-depth understanding of client work, and present and/or facilitate meetings as requested

Relationships, Culture & Organizational Expertise


  • Build and maintain strong relationships across all levels, teams, and locations—providing consistent communication and timely, practical guidance; shaping culture, and driving organizational priorities
  • Guide Department Heads and People Managers through all aspects of the employee lifecycle, advising on off-cycle promotions, job descriptions, and compensation-related processes; prepare leaders for conversations and draft supporting documentation
  • Advise managers on staff development and well-being, including onboarding, training resources, performance improvement plans, progressive discipline, and terminations
  • Develop and coach managers to lead effectively, providing hands-on support and applying a strong understanding of employment law in partnership with Legal
  • Provide expert guidance to employees and managers on communication, conflict resolution, career development, and professional growth
  • Apply performance management philosophy in practice—guiding goal setting, feedback, performance reviews, and retention strategies
  • Participate in cross-team critical work such as key new hire interviews, , and complex compensation conversations

People Team Partnership


  • Regularly engage with the rest of the People Team and collaborate as needed to partner in problem-solving for staff challenges or concerns; exercising sound judgment, discretion, and confidentiality
  • Streamline People Team engagement and the client experience across the organization by building strong relationships, furthering the organization’s trust in the People Team
  • Share client feedback with other parts of the People Team to enhance support and collaboration; provide context when complex issues arise to navigate the nuances of a challenging situation
  • Educate managers on Leave and Compensation policies, connecting them to the appropriate resources and teams
  • Partner closely with Talent Acquisition to support internal hiring, ensuring a seamless, transparent, and equitable experience while navigating complex situations

Qualifications:

  • Ability to partner with, engage and influence senior organizational leaders
  • Proven ability to influence others without being part of the management hierarchy
  • Must possess excellent communication (both oral and written), and coaching skills
  • Must have a high level of interpersonal skills to handle sensitive and confidential situations
  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing tasks and demands
  • Must possess a high level of resiliency and maintain a professional demeanor
  • Ability to work evenings and weekends, as needed
  • Ability to work two pre-planned on-call weekends a quarter to answer any pressing questions from all teams required
  • Experience working with a remote workforce at varying levels preferred
  • Must be comfortable with a certain level of legal involvement and risk associated with this work
  • Ability to exemplify ASPCA’s core values, behavioral competencies

Education and Work Experience:

  • B.A./B.S. degree preferred or equivalent experience
  • High School degree or GED required
  • At least 3 years of HR business partner, people partner, or experience in an equivalent role directly advising leaders on employee relations (including investigations), performance management, and organizational effectiveness required
  • At least 5 years of experience with and demonstrated success managing a team or equivalent experience required
  • Knowledge of employment laws in the United States required
  • Experience planning and facilitating meetings, trainings or workshops strongly preferred
  • Experience tracking and analyzing data to guide work is preferred
  • Proficiency with Airtable, Canva, Culture Amp, and the Microsoft Office Suite is a plus
  • Experience managing organizational change/restructures required
  • Experience advising and coaching leaders on complex employee performance, conduct, and team effectiveness matters highly preferred

Language:

English (Required)

Education and Work Experience:

Bachelors, High School Diploma, GED, or Equivalent Experience (Required)

raw.description:
Where Human Connection Fuels Possibility ​

At Maritz, decades of innovation and perseverance have built more than just a strong reputation — they’ve shaped a culture where human connection and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do. ​

Joining Maritz means becoming part of a workplace grounded in a critical truth; people and their potential is our greatest resource.

​

Maritz helps companies achieve their business goals by inspiring people to perform their best. We design experiences, incentives, and recognition programs that spark action and deliver measurable impact.​

And we’ve brought this human-first design inward – intentionally building teams that care for each other and collaborate powerfully. In our most recent employee survey, nearly 90% of respondents said that their managers care about their concerns and 82% said they feel genuinely appreciated. We know that when employees feel seen, supported, and celebrated for who they are, they thrive and so does our business. ​

That’s why we’ve created a flexible, environment that empowers you to do your best work without sacrificing what matters most to you. In fact, in that same survey, nearly 90% of respondents said they have the flexibility they need to balance work and personal life and nearly 80% said Maritz does a great job prioritizing employee well being.​

We have a passion for excellence and genuine care for the people making it possible.

Provides a centralized point of leadership for coordination and execution of face to face, digital and hybrid events/programs within a team so that operational excellence results with all program operations. Strives to meet client needs, specifications, objectives, and quality standards. Work with the collective event management team and direct reports to maximize contribution margin by effectively managing the customer experience, balancing customer satisfaction, employee satisfaction and organizational cost. This position centers heavily around accounting and compliance.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead, mentor, and coach Event Management team members across markets and event types, including performance management, development conversations, and goal setting.
  • Coordinate regular team meetings, communications, onboarding support, and training initiatives.
  • Oversee labor management, time tracking, T&E reporting, and invoicing approvals to ensure accuracy and compliance.
  • Provide Event Management support for assigned target accounts, including project oversight, relationship management, and financial and compliance management.
  • Ensure adherence to workflows, client SOPs, and best practices across accounts for operational consistency.
  • Review and audit team transactions and deliver monthly and quarterly reporting for SLA, finance, compliance, and event management.
  • Support new initiatives, processes, and continuous improvement efforts across the organization.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 3–5 years of experience in meetings, events, and/or incentive travel (pre- and/or post-sale).
  • 1–2 years of proven supervisory or people leadership experience preferred.
  • Experience managing budgets and financial oversight for programs or accounts.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and motivational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to work effectively with all levels of an organization, including clients and external partners.

Nice To Have

  • Global travel or hospitality industry experience.
  • Understanding of experience design and the ability to articulate event outcomes tied to business objectives.
  • Professional certifications such as PMP, CMP, CIS, CITP, HMCC, or DES.
  • Experience with congress and internal meetings
  • Preferred location in Raritan NJ or Cincinnati OH

Working Logistics & Things You Should Know

  • Onsite expectations may vary based on team and business needs.
  • Travel may be required based on client programs, team support, or business initiatives.

It is not designed to confirm or be interpreted as a comprehensive summary of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of associates assigned to this job.

raw.title: Infrastructure Solutions Architect - OEM
raw.excerpt: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years.
raw.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We are looking for an Infrastructure Solutions Architect to help revolutionize computing. At NVIDIA, we encourage an inclusive and collaborative environment where ambitious individuals can grow. Our dedication to innovation and excellence has made us a leader in technology. We are now seeking outstanding talent to join us on this journey.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Serve as the senior technical point of contact for OEM Federal deployments of NVIDIA GPU-accelerated platforms, including PCIe GPUs, HGX, and MGX systems, addressing any blocking issues.

  • Own Issues End to End: Take responsibility for customer issues from start to finish — prioritizing platform, firmware, and workload problems. Drive these issues through the OEM's support tiers into NVIDIA engineering with the necessary logs and reproduction details to identify the root cause. Follow through with the customer until resolution.

  • Failure Analysis & RMA: Establish and complete diagnostic, RMA eligibility, and replacement procedures for Federal deployments. This includes situations where failed hardware and logs must remain on-site at the customer facility.

  • Navigate Federal security frameworks including FedRAMP, IL5/IL6, and air-gapped (SCIF) environments, and help the customer meet sanitization and chain-of-custody requirements for hardware returns.

  • Partner with OEM Federal support and services teams to reduce blocking issues and unnecessary dispatches. Detail failure signatures to build the Federal knowledge base and apply AI tools where the environment allows.

What we need to see:

  • Due to the classified nature of the work, the selected candidate must be a U.S. citizen and possess and maintain an active U.S. Government TS/SCI clearance. Certain Intelligence Community customer assignments may also require a current U.S. Government-administered Counterintelligence Scope or Full Scope Polygraph.

  • BS or MS in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience

  • 5+ years of engineering experience on multi-GPU platforms, including at least 3 years in a customer-facing support, field engineering, or blocking issue role.

  • Strong system software expertise across firmware, BIOS, kernel, drivers, and operating systems, with the ability to troubleshoot, optimize, and customize Linux environments for AI/ML workloads.

  • Expert knowledge of data center infrastructure — x86/ARM systems, high-performance storage, and low-latency networking (InfiniBand/RDMA).

  • Professional-level communication and organizational skills, including adjusting to the technical level of the audience, staying calm and focused in negative situations, and driving issues through to closure.

  • This role requires up to 35% travel to customer, partner, and data center sites, including secure facilities, and occasional weekend and holiday coverage.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Dell Ecosystem Expertise: Proven experience with Dell PowerEdge GPU servers and Dell's management software (OpenManage, APEX), and familiarity with Dell's support and process for handling blocking issues.

  • Federal Mission Experience: Direct experience supporting DoD, Intelligence Community, or Civilian agency deployments, and comfort operating within their security and logistics constraints.

  • Programming Depth: Proficiency in Python for building custom diagnostic and analysis tooling, and C/C++ for platform OS, firmware, and driver work.

  • Cluster & HPC Technologies: Containerized and scheduled environments (Docker, Kubernetes, Slurm) and upper layer protocols such as NCCL and MPI.

  • Performance Analysis: Experience analyzing performance of distributed GPU-accelerated workloads.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative, results-oriented and enjoy learning while having fun, then what are you waiting for? Apply today!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD - 241,500 USD for Level 3, and 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 21, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

raw.title: Software Engineering - Lead Data Scientist
raw.excerpt: FICO (NYSE: FICO)is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions.
raw.description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO)is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity

The myFICO (Scores B2C) engineering team is seeking a Lead Data Scientist to build and run machine learning and Generative AI solutions in our consumer applications. This lead-level software engineering role builds the data pipelines that prepare large datasets for modeling, develops ML models and puts them into production with monitoring and retraining, and measures business impact through experimentation. You will also set ML engineering best practices for the team.

What You’ll Contribute

  • Build and maintain Python data pipelines that ingest, clean, and transform large datasets into reliable, analysis-ready data and ML features.
  • Profile and validate data, and put quality checks in place so models and analyses can be trusted.
  • Develop machine learning models, such as propensity, churn, segmentation, and forecasting, from problem framing through evaluation.
  • Deploy models to production in AWS for batch and real-time scoring, monitor performance and drift, and automate retraining.
  • Design, evaluate, and improve LLM prompts, and integrate Generative AI capabilities into existing applications.
  • Design and analyze A/B tests to measure business impact, and explain results to product and marketing partners.
  • Lead design discussions and code reviews, mentor engineers and analysts, and set ML engineering best practices.
  • Partner with database engineering, product management, and InfoSec to build secure, compliant solutions that handle sensitive consumer data responsibly.
  • Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows, such as Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, to accelerate delivery while reviewing and refining their output.

What We’re Seeking

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field, with demonstrated experience in data science, machine learning engineering, or applied AI, including models running in production.
  • Strong Python for data engineering and ML (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PySpark), with comfort working in Jupyter notebooks.
  • Proven experience building data pipelines and processing large datasets with Spark, Redshift, or similar technologies, plus expert SQL skills for complex queries on large datasets.
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as XGBoost, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
  • Experience operationalizing ML models, including deployment, monitoring, retraining, and CI/CD (SageMaker, MLflow, Docker, or similar), and running data and ML workloads in AWS (S3, Glue, Lambda, Bedrock, or similar).
  • Experience with LLMs (Claude, OpenAI GPT, or similar), including prompt design, evaluation, and deploying Generative AI solutions in production.
  • Strong grounding in statistics, experimental design, and hypothesis testing.
  • Production ownership, including code review, release management, and mentoring, with the ability to explain technical results to non-technical partners.
  • Experience with RAG workflows, vector stores, MCP server integrations, LLM fine-tuning, workflow orchestration (Airflow, Step Functions), or regulated consumer data such as credit and financial services is a plus.

Our Offer to You

  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.
  • The targeted base pay range for this role is: $105,000 to $165,000 with this range reflecting differences in candidate knowledge, skills and experience.

Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

• Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.

• Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.

• Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at

FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.

Information submitted with your application is subject to the FICO Privacy policy at

raw.description:
Government Employees Health Association, Inc. (G.E.H.A) is a nonprofit member association that provides health and dental benefits that millions of federal employees and retirees, military retirees and their families have counted on since 1937. Offering one of the largest health and dental benefit provider networks available to federal employees in the United States, G.E.H.A empowers health and wellness by meeting its members where they are, when they need care.

G.E.H.A has one mission: To empower federal workers to be healthy and well.

As a Senior AI Context Engineer in Digital Innovation, you turn raw, structured and unstructured enterprise information—such as policy documents, brochures, and clinical records—into accurate, high-quality context for AI applications. Positioned at the intersection of applied data science and software engineering, you focus on the quality, semantic structuring, and retrieval accuracy of data consumed by G.E.H.A’s AI solutions. You own the extraction, document chunking, vector indexing, and RAG retrieval mechanics that power G.E.H.A’s AI tools.

Operating closely with the Sr. AI Solutions Architect, AI Full Stack Developer, and enterprise partners, you serve as the contextual bridge between the enterprise Data & Analytics, Digital Innovation and enterprise applications. In this role, you establish data enrichment, retrieval and evaluation frameworks that ensure AI agents have fast, secure, and compliant access to business context, all while leveraging enterprise cloud and data infrastructure.

SKILLS

Duties and Responsibilities:

Context Engineering & Retrieval Optimization

  • Extraction & Chunking: Build and refine advanced structured and unstructured information parsing, layouts processing, and chunking workflows (converting PDFs, clinical notes, data, and policy docs) into high-quality contextual units for LLMs in partnership with cross-functional teams.
  • Semantic Search & Reranking: Implement hybrid search mechanics, metadata routing, and reranking logic to drastically improve retrieval precision and minimize model hallucinations.
  • Agentic Context Services: Design context payload specifications and metadata structures that feed into Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and LLM orchestration tools built by application developers.

Vector Indexing & Retrieval Architecture

  • Index Design & Optimization: Recommends and implements vector indexing strategies, embedding schemes, and semantic query designs inside enterprise-provisioned vector stores (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, Azure AI Search) to ensure high-performance, low-latency retrieval.
  • Vector Metadata: Design and manage sophisticated metadata tagging schemes to enable precise filtering, hybrid search, and domain-specific context retrieval.
  • Retrieval Evaluation & Groundedness: Establish automated evaluation frameworks to continuously monitor retrieval relevance, context quality, groundedness scores, and embedding drift over time.

Context Security, Compliance & Governance

  • Healthcare Context Compliance: Ensure all document processing and contextual payloads strictly adhere to HIPAA and HITRUST standards, implementing automated masking and tokenization for Protected Health Information (PHI).
  • Context-Level Access Control: Ensure role-based access control (RBAC) rules within vector metadata, ensuring AI search queries only return contextual snippets that the active user is authorized to see.
  • Auditing & Hand-off Lineage: Maintain context tracking and audit logs for prompt payloads, establishing clean data hand-off specifications when transitioning validated innovation prototypes to enterprise Data & Analytics or IT teams.

Collaborative Execution

  • Reference Pattern Alignment: Build upon the reference architectures, CI/CD templates, and "golden paths" established by the Sr. AI Solutions Architect.
  • Product Support: Work alongside the AI Product Owner and AI Full Stack Developers to rapidly supply high-accuracy context layers for upcoming GenAI features.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in backend software engineering, applied machine learning/search, or data-centric application development.
  • GenAI & RAG Focus: 1–2 years of hands-on experience specifically optimizing AI and RAG architectures, prompt context strategies, and vector retrieval pipelines for LLM applications.
  • Programming & Tooling: Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, alongside familiarity with modern orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Temporal).
  • Unstructured Content Parsing: Deep experience using parsing frameworks (e.g., LlamaIndex, Unstructured.io, LangChain document loaders) to process complex layouts, tables, and unstructured documents.
  • Vector & Search Engines: Hands-on experience working with vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search platforms (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, Weaviate, Qdrant, Azure AI Search).
  • Evaluation Frameworks: Familiarity with RAG and LLM context evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, TruLens, Arize Phoenix) to measure retrieval recall, precision, and groundedness.
  • Data Security & Privacy: Practical experience handling sensitive healthcare data (PHI/PII) within high-compliance software environments.

Work-at-home requirements

  • Must have the ability to provide a non-cellular High Speed Internet Service such as Fiber, DSL, or cable Modems for a home office.

  • A minimum standard speed for optimal performance of 30x5 (30mpbs download x 5mpbs upload) is required.

  • Latency (ping) response time lower than 80 ms

  • Hotspots, satellite and wireless internet service is NOT allowed for this role.

  • A dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information

How we value you

  • Competitive pay/salary ranges

  • Incentive plan

  • Health/Vision/Dental benefits effective day one

  • 401(k) retirement plan: company match – dollar for dollar up to 4% employee contribution (pretax or Roth options) plus a 6% annual company contribution

  • Robust employee well-being program

  • Paid Time Off

  • Personal Community Enrichment Time

  • Company-provided Basic Life and AD&D

  • Company-provided Short-Term & Long-Term Disability

  • Tuition Assistance Program

While this is a remote opportunity, at this time G.E.H.A does not hire employees from U.S. territories or the following states: Alaska, Hawaii, California, Washington, Oregon, Colorado, Wyoming, Montana, New York, Connecticut, Vermont, Pennsylvania, Maine.

Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. G.E.H.A considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, as well as, market and business considerations when extending an offer.

The target hiring range for this position is $124,666 - $157,710 USD. At G.E.H.A, the current maximum salary for this role is $175,734 USD. While initial compensation may vary based on experience and qualifications, there is a path to work toward this top rate through performance and continued growth within the organization.

G.E.H.A is an Equal Opportunity Employer, which means we will not discriminate against any individual based on sex, race, color, national origin, disability, religion, age, military status, genetic information, veteran status, pregnancy, marital status, gender identity, and sexual orientation, as well as all other characteristics and qualities protected by federal, state, or local law. G.E.H.A will not discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their compensation or the compensation of another employee or applicant. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

G.E.H.A is headquartered in Lee's Summit, Missouri, in the Kansas City area. We recognize the importance of balance and flexibility and offer hybrid and work-from-home options for many of our roles.
