raw.description:
What is special about Lighthouse?

Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together.

What’s unique about this role?

The Discovery Consultant supports outside sales professionals to maximize revenue with existing clients and target prospects through both pre-close and post-sales activities. This role allows outside sales professionals to maximize selling time and revenue generation.

What will this person do?

  • Assist the outside sales professionals in generation of new leads, projects, and institutional client relationships
  • Help develop and implement strategic sales plan to deepen relationships with new and existing clients. Maintain Strategic Account Plan in Salesforce.com
  • Help set meetings for Vice President and perform outbound for conferences
  • Maintain accurate sales pipeline data and sales activities within Salesforce.com including accounts, opportunities, tasks/activities, and contacts
  • Help prepare, proof, and deliver project proposals and responses to RFPs/RFIs for eDiscovery services
  • Prepare and submit estimates for new client projects
  • Support upcoming meetings including initial PowerPoint creation and management as well as other required materials
  • Manage contracting process including document creation from templates, submitting contracting requests, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, and contract negotiation support
  • Ensure proper setup of new projects within internal systems
  • Coordinate with project management, collections, and operations teams to ensure seamless delivery of services
  • Assist with client and prospect relationship management including follow up communication, resolving billing issues, conducting price / contract negotiations
  • Prepare and submit client reporting and budget updates to clients
  • Review monthly invoices to confirm accurate pricing and adherence to budget
  • Proactively identify opportunities to take on tasks that free the outside sales professionals to interact more with clients and prospects
  • Commit to ongoing education, research, tracking and communication of industry trends, best practices, and competitive service offerings to identify opportunities for growth, innovation, increased market share, and competitive advantage
  • Perform other related duties as assigned

Bring your passion and together we will shine. It would also be great if you had the following:

  • Strong written communication skills with the ability to create compelling sales meeting presentation materials and proposal responses
  • Strong verbal communications skills to address client information needs and articulate points of differentiation clearly and succinctly
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Strong attention to detail including the ability to thoroughly quality check work product
  • Ability to build trusted and lasting relationships with both external and internal customers and peers
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills (Exchange, PowerPoint, Word, Excel)
  • Familiarity with CRM tools like Salesforce.com
  • Demonstrate a consistently high activity level and be extremely self-motivated
  • BA or BS degree required
  • Experience supporting a sales team with prospecting, listening, follow-up, team selling and account planning is a plus
  • Experience working with providers of electronic discovery (ESI), attorney document review, or other litigation support services to Fortune 1000 corporations and AM 200 law firms a plus

Work Environment and Physical Demands

  • Duties are performed in a typical office environment while at a desk or computer table.
  • Duties require the ability to use a computer, communicate over the telephone, and read printed material, in a quiet and professional setting.
  • Duties may require being on call periodically and working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends).
  • Duties may require the ability to lift to 20 lbs.

Lighthouse celebrates and thrives on diversity and is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire, train, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We welcome any talents and contributions you can bring to the team and are deeply committed to growing an environment where everyone can feel safe, is respected, and can show up as themselves. Come as you are!

As required by applicable pay transparency laws, Lighthouse complies with compensation disclosure requirements for roles that may be hired in locations under these requirements. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include a wide array of factors, including: your specific skills and experience, geographic location, or other relevant factors. The salary range for this position may be tailored to be lower or higher in different talent markets.

Lighthouse offers a comprehensive quality benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and a 401k with company match. Company paid benefits also include Life & AD&D, short and long-term disability, telemedicine, and other wellness plans. We offer a generous Flexible PTO program and paid volunteer days. Employees may also participate in voluntary insurance plans including accident, hospitalization, and critical illness plans as well as pet insurance.

This role will be eligible to participate in an annual bonus or incentive program.

As a trailblazer and catalyst for change, Lighthouse rises to each opportunity to help our clients, and our people do what they do best—shine.

What’s unique about this role?

The Solution Consultant (Linguistic Modeling) supports the team’s goals by leading teams in the use of complex methodologies, protocols, and tools for classifying electronically stored information for a variety of designations (e.g., privilege, confidentiality, responsiveness, issues, and class- or document-types). Linguistic-modeling-based classifications serve two primary use cases: solutions delivered directly to clients to meet consultant-scoped needs; and solutions delivered as optimizations to Lighthouse-internal workflows in adjacent service offerings. Solution Consultant is a lead-level position in linguistic modeling and search services, requiring a mastery of search/analytics software and the ability to scope client needs, design technical and process solutions, lead a team’s execution, proactively communicate, identify risk, and mentor less experienced team members.

What will this person do?

  • Masters DART/Lighthouse Search syntax and functionality
  • Leads Linguistic Modeling project teams for the following:
    • Keyword/search term consultation, generation, and optimization
    • Confidentiality classification
    • Topical filtering
    • Potential privilege classification
    • Custom-built classification
  • Develops ownership in the following areas, sometimes with guidance:
    • Project scoping
    • Technical and process solution design, including non-standard solutions
    • Incorporation of evolving technologies into workflows
    • Client communications

Bring your passion and together we will shine. It would also be great if you had the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher or equivalent additional years of experience in professional or academic experience with research, data mining, strategic search, data analysis, text analysis, technology-assisted review (TAR), Electronically Stored Information (ESI), content management or linguistic analysis

  • Keen attention to detail and a practiced sense of order and organization

The Payment Application Specialist ensures accurate and timely payment posting by thoroughly researching and resolving discrepancies between Athena and USACS systems. Additionally, they collaborate closely with internal teams and external payers to maintain data integrity, optimize revenue cycle processes, and support overall financial accuracy.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Proficiency with Windows-based PC hardware and software, especially spreadsheet applications for data analysis and reporting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills to independently identify, research, and resolve complex discrepancies, communicating results clearly to management.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication abilities for professional interaction with employees, management, and external stakeholders.
  • Strict commitment to maintaining confidentiality of sensitive patient and financial information.
  • Highly organized with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to work overtime and contribute extra effort during peak periods or special projects.
  • Exceptional attention to detail to ensure accuracy in all tasks.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required; additional education or certifications in finance, accounting, or healthcare administration preferred.
  • Experience with Health Insurance Websites/Portals required.
  • Experience with Financial Records to resolve missing payments required.
  • Proficient in review of Explanation of Benefits and Posting required.
  • Prior experience in payment processing, revenue cycle management, or related financial operations preferred.

Channel Account Manager

Position Summary

Uniguest is seeking an experienced Channel Account Manager to grow revenue and expand our channel presence across key U.S. markets.

This remote role is responsible for building reseller relationships, developing new business, and achieving Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) targets. The Channel Account Manager will work with AV/IT resellers, integrators, consultants, and internal sales teams to position Uniguest solutions, including IPTV, digital signage CMS, and interactive kiosks.

Reporting to the Director of Channel Sales, this role requires up to 40% travel.

What you’ll do

  • Execute Uniguest’s channel sales strategy to achieve ARR and revenue targets.
  • Build and grow relationships with AV/IT resellers, integrators, and channel partners.
  • Identify and onboard new reseller partners to expand market coverage.
  • Generate new sales opportunities through partners, networking, industry events, and targeted outreach.
  • Work with technology consultants and IT integrators to specify Uniguest solutions in major projects.
  • Partner with resellers on lead generation, customer presentations, and sales training.
  • Work with the End User Sales team to develop and advance opportunities through close.
  • Maintain a healthy pipeline aligned with assigned sales targets.
  • Keep accurate Salesforce records for opportunities, activities, pipeline, and forecasting.
  • Develop strong knowledge of customer needs, industry trends, competitors, and technology within assigned markets.
  • Build long-term partner relationships that support revenue growth and market expansion.
  • All other duties as assigned.

How to Succeed in the Role

  • Be proactive and comfortable creating new opportunities.
  • Take ownership of partner relationships, pipeline, ARR targets, and results.
  • Build genuine, long-term relationships with resellers, integrators, consultants, and customers.
  • Be curious and consultative when identifying customer and partner needs.
  • Communicate confidently with executives, partners, consultants, and technical stakeholders.
  • Be comfortable discussing IPTV, digital signage, CMS platforms, interactive kiosks, and related AV/IT technology.
  • Translate technical solutions into clear business value.
  • Stay organized and consistent with follow-up, Salesforce activity, pipeline, and forecasting.
  • Be persistent throughout complex enterprise and channel sales cycles.
  • Work collaboratively across Sales, Presales, Delivery, and Support.
  • Be adaptable and comfortable working in a growing organization.

The Profile that Stands Out

Deep channel sales experience and strong knowledge of the AV/IT marketare important for this role. The ideal candidate is a self-directed, relationship-driven sales professional with at least five years of experience selling to senior decision-makers through a reseller or channel model.

The strongest candidates will have an established U.S. AV reseller and integrator network and experience with IPTV, digital signage, CMS platforms, interactive kiosks, or related technologies. Strong Salesforce experience and a proven record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets are also important.

This role requires up to 40% travel.

What's in it for You

You will be backed by a team who loves to win and surrounded by experts across Sales, Presales, Delivery, and Support. You will have the opportunity to grow strategic channel relationships while representing video-based technology solutions used by enterprise customers.

Uniguest offers competitive benefits, including health, dental, vision, and retirement plans based on position, location, and eligibility. We also offer an Employee Assistance Program, employee recognition programs, career development opportunities, and a performance-based commission plan.

Position Purpose:

Magpie Health Analytics (Magpie) is seeking a full-time, remote Human Resources Manager to lead the day-to-day operation and continued development of the company’s Human Resources function. The position is responsible for recruiting and hiring support, onboarding and offboarding, employee relations, benefits and leave administration, HR policies and records, and other employment practices supporting Magpie’s growing workforce.

The Human Resources Manager will serve as Magpie’s primary HR resource for employees and managers and will help develop scalable HR processes and practices as the company continues to grow. The position requires someone who can independently handle routine HR matters, research and develop approaches to new or unfamiliar issues, and recognize when management, legal counsel, or other specialized expertise should be engaged.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

This position is responsible for both the day-to-day operation and continued development of Magpie’s Human Resources function.

  • Serve as Magpie’s primary HR resource for employees and managers, providing practical guidance and support on routine employment matters.
  • Manage recruiting and hiring processes for approved positions, including job descriptions, postings, candidate coordination, offers, background checks, drug screening, and other pre-employment activities.
  • Manage employee onboarding and offboarding and coordinate required activities with managers and other Magpie functions.
  • Administer employee benefits, leave, PTO, personnel records, HR documentation, and related employee programs.
  • Support managers with employee relations, performance management, workplace concerns, and other people-management matters.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve HR policies, procedures, workflows, forms, templates, and other practices that support a growing organization.
  • Review HR practices to identify gaps, inconsistencies, risks, and opportunities for improvement and implement appropriate solutions.
  • Monitor applicable federal, state, and local employment requirements and incorporate them into Magpie’s HR practices as the company grows and enters new jurisdictions.
  • Coordinate with Contracts, Compliance, IT & Security, project leadership, payroll, benefits providers, and other functions to ensure HR processes support Magpie’s business and federal-contractor workforce requirements.
  • Research new or unfamiliar HR issues, develop practical approaches and recommendations, and recognize when management, legal counsel, or other specialized expertise should be engaged.
  • Help build scalable HR systems and practices that allow routine people matters to be handled consistently and effectively as Magpie continues to grow

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7+ years of progressively responsible Human Resources experience, including experience independently managing a broad range of HR responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated experience with recruiting, hiring, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, benefits, leave administration, and employee separation.
  • Working knowledge of federal and state employment requirements and experience supporting employees across multiple states.
  • Demonstrated ability to research unfamiliar HR issues, evaluate requirements and options, and develop practical recommendations.
  • Experience developing and improving HR policies, procedures, processes, and documentation rather than solely administering established processes.
  • Sound judgment regarding matters that can be handled independently and those requiring management, legal, or other specialized review.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to work effectively with executives, managers, employees, and external professional advisors.
  • Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting a small or rapidly growing professional-services organization.
  • Experience supporting federal government contractors or other regulated organizations.
  • Experience supporting a geographically distributed or multi-state workforce.
  • Familiarity with federal-contractor workforce requirements, including background investigations, suitability or credentialing, employment eligibility, and contract-specific personnel requirements.
  • Experience developing HR infrastructure for an organization experiencing significant workforce growth.
  • SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, SPHR, or similar professional certification.
  • Experience coordinating with outside employment counsel, benefits providers, payroll providers, and other specialized HR resources.

Job Summary

The primary purpose for this position is to make innovative and ingenious contributions to new solution/product design and implementation based on an understanding of applicable technology and how it can be applied to solution/product design, considerations of system-wide impact, hardware-software tradeoffs, and business issues for Managed Services clients. This position will provide oversight and project guidance and will also take a lead technical role in reviewing and modifying Managed Services Solutions. This position is also a key contributor to the Managed Services engineering team responsible for supporting complex technical services and solutions, which may include, but is not limited to: Enterprise data storage systems, mainframe, midrange, Windows, and/or Unix/Linux systems, network infrastructure environments, virtualized systems, and database systems.

What you will do:

  • Provides technical consultation in analyzing client’s requirements, recommending solutions and assisting sales and other engineers with development of proposals, quotations and presentations.
  • Responsible for technical sales support.
  • Provides leadership and advice/counsel on technical subject matters and architecture design to Customers, the Managed Services Team, and other organization teams. Recognized by customer, peers, and management as SME expert, staying relevant in upcoming technologies, IT trends and IT transformation.
  • Maintains client relationships as a trusted Technical Advisor. Serves as focal point for communications between CDW and Managed Services clients, when necessary, using experience and judgment to communicate effectively to all parties.
  • Conducts/leads design workshops for complex designs to meet customer, business, and technical objectives.
  • Mentor other engineers to apply engineering background knowledge for Managed Services project design, analysis, and project coordination of services or products.
  • Research current and emerging technologies, evaluates alternatives, makes recommendations, and presents reports to management.
  • Develops, improves, and maintains customer presentations, demo instructions, training documentation, templates, and other related collateral.
  • Enhance, develops, and follows vendor training requirements, certifications and provides guidance, support and education to fellow engineers.
  • Assists organizational resources to assess the amount of effort required for services engagements and provide technical input for the Scopes/Statement of Work generation
  • Designs and oversees upgrades to advanced and complex client infrastructure solutions. Transfers technical skills and knowledge to client and peers.
  • Provide implementation, upgrades, tuning, back-ups, restores, user management and other technical support services to Managed Services clients to meet their business needs
  • Follows change control, incident response, and testing processes
  • Understand and deliver Managed Services offerings as outlined in the CDW Service Descriptions and Service Catalog
  • Clearly and concisely articulate problems and solutions for issues to clients through various forms of communication
  • As needed, a member of on-call rotation to provide 24 X 7 support to critical systems and ensure availability objectives are met. To provide the required coverage, must be willing to work other shifts including weekends, holidays, and overtime
  • Escalation resources of on-call rotation. Support of engineering peers for complex technical issues and business critical situations.
  • Participate and lead various client projects intended to continually improve/upgrade technology infrastructures
  • Review, create and execute test plans to meet project requirements for assigned components
  • Design and implement complex solutions, including automation and technology, to streamline processes and build efficiency.
  • Conduct expert throughput analysis, problem solving, root cause analysis, and infrastructure planning
  • Identify and communicate potential opportunities for cross-selling to the sales team
  • Assist Professional Services team when required with client including assessing and recommending architectural designs/changes to client systems in response to performance issues, growth requirements, etc.
  • Complete projects/tasks on a timely basis, according to commitments made to stakeholders and management
  • Perform scopes of work as detailed in implementation plans assigned (system builds, test plans, documentation, training, etc.)
  • Understand SLAs in a production environment and proactively strive to meet the commitments
  • Collaborate and support cross-functionally with Customer Success, Project Management, R&D, and Sales.
  • Tests, evaluates, and develops new products, offerings, and solutions
  • Conducts training of customers and company employees in both formal and informal environments
  • Review assigned service requests daily, follow up and provide status updates to clients; ensure data pertaining to the status of service request is entered into the problem tracking systems accurately and promptly to provide an up-to-date picture of service delivery status and backlog
  • Addresses and updates customer incident tickets and change orders, providing internal management and customer account managers with status information

What we expect of you:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 7 years of IT engineering experience (including the 5 years large-scale requisite DC experience listed below), OR 11 total years of IT engineering experience, to include a minimum of 5 years large-scale, multi-tenant Data Center environment with enterprise-class planning, design, implementation and support experience with one or more infrastructure solutions supported by the Managed Services practice (Networking Infrastructure, Enterprise Storage, Mainframe, Midrange, Windows, and/or Unix/Linux systems, virtualization technologies, monitoring infrastructure, databases, and/or security tools).
  • Demonstrated ability to apply technical background and knowledge to business direction and provide real business-based customer outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop project plans and schedules to complete complex projects or new solution/product development
  • Ability to establish customer trust and confidence in the CDW Managed Services knowledge of and concern for customers’ business needs.
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities simultaneously and adapt to the changing needs of the customers while meeting deadlines.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to perform root cause analysis and drive lasting solutions.
  • Ability to consistently follow policies and procedures.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively with colleagues, customers, and leadership teams including C-Level executives.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently.
  • Ability to work with a team and provide guidance, mentorship, and support of peers.
  • Strong time management skills and ability to meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrates and actively promotes an understanding and commitment to the mission of CDW through performing behaviors consistent with the CDW Way.
  • Working knowledge in a number of the following technology areas:
  • Scripting Coding skill set: Python, Bash, Perl, Ruby, TLC
  • Hardware:
    • Switches – Cisco, Juniper, Arista, Aruba
    • Routers – Cisco, Juniper, Arista, Aruba
    • Firewalls - Cisco ASA/FTD, Palo Alto
    • Load Balancers - Cisco ACE, CSS, F5 LTM, F5 GSM, Citrix
    • WAN Optimization - Riverbed Steelhead and Cisco WAAS
  • Network Technologies/Topologies:
  • WAN - MPLS, MPLS Layer 2/3 VPN’s, Frame-Relay, GRE/IPSEC VPN, VPN, SIP/PSTN services
    • Layer 2 networking - 802.1(D,W,S) , Ethernet, PPoE, Ether-Channel
    • Layer 3 networking - IPv4, IPv6, OSPF, EIGRP, RIP (v2), BGP, MP-BGP, PFR, OSPFv3, EIGRPv6, RIPng, Advanced Redistribution, VRF-lite
    • Multicast Networking - Multicast (Sparse + Dense), MSDP, Anycast, Auto-RP, BSR, PIM, SSM
    • Security - CBAC, Zone-Based firewall, Reflex ACL, NAT, IP Source Guard, uRPF, Cisco IPS/IPS, RSA Envision
    • QOS – Congestion avoidance and congestion management. MQC, CBWFQ, LLQ, NBAR, WRED, Auto-QOS
    • VOIP - Cisco voice gateway functionality, SRST
    • Unified Computing/Virtualization - Design, support, configure, upgrade Cisco UCS systems
    • Data Center - FabricPath, FEX, vPC, UCS, FCoE
    • Wireless – Cisco Wireless LAN controllers, lightweight and autonomous AP models, Cisco Prime Infrastructure, MSE, Aruba and Meraki
    • VPN - SSL VPN, IPSec VPN, and DMVPN (phase 1 and 2), EZVPN, Anyconnect
  • Ability to travel as needed.
  • Experience in a large data center environment, a plus.
  • 5 Years Managed Services Experience, a plus.
  • Current Cisco CCNP certifications required; Cisco CCIE certification, a plus.
  • Industry-recognized technical certifications in related disciplines, a plus.

Pay range: $126,000.00 - $193,200.00 depending on experience and skill set
Annual bonus target of 10% subject to terms and conditions of plan
Benefits overview:
Salary ranges may be subject to geographic differentials

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization

We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.

What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.

Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do. Together, we Make Amazing Happen.

About you

The Senior Lease Analyst - RENT is responsible for managing Lease Administration functions and implementations, client and vendor relationships, and centralizing, establishing and producing schedules, reports, communication plans, and process flow for the Lease Administration team. This position primarily manages medium to large accounts characterized by high complexity, often within a global account management framework, with an emphasis on global rent presentment or rent payment activities.


In this role, you will…

  • Serve as the main point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders regarding global lease administration matters
  • Understand client business objectives, real estate portfolio strategy, and service expectation's
  • Maintain thorough understanding of client agreements for assigned accounts including boundaries of scope of work, fee structure, billing frequency and payee information. Ensure this information has been correctly entered and maintained as a client contract in WorkTrac.
  • Conduct regular meetings and reviews with clients to present portfolio updates, key metrics, and performance reports.
  • Develop and maintain strong client governance programs such as reporting cadence, communication methods, business reviews, etc.
  • Track, maintain, and communicate all expirations, option exercise dates, and other critical information.

  • Proactively identify account related risks and formulate appropriate mitigation strategies; project manage through solution.

  • Prepare and review lease-related financial statements, disclosures, reports, and monthly rental payment schedules and reconciliations as required.
  • Produce variance reports comparing budgeted versus actual rent obligations.
  • Experience overseeing 3rd party utility management payments.· Track and collaborate on TI allowance disbursements / landlord obligation fulfillment.
  • Manage and maintain lease accounting records in accordance with US GAAP (ASC 842) and IFRS 16 within lease management platform's
  • Ensure compliance with lease accounting standards and company policies.
  • Track A/R for assigned clients and escalate to appropriate parties.
  • Reconcile accounts with outstanding balances and work with Landlords and clients to resolve any disputes. (eg. Landlord Ledger reconciliations)
  • Assist with internal and external audits.
  • Assist with monitoring, reviewing and approving all Rent, CAM, Operating Expense, Tax and Insurance payments to Landlords, including reviewing leases to insure accuracy of all charges.· Review and validate Consumer Price Index adjustments as provided in legal documents.
  • Maintain file systems, including the data integrity of information contained in the database application used for tracking all Tenant and Lease related data.
  • Maintain a record of exceptions and resolve within the database.
  • Assist transition manager with new account onboarding and transition process for assigned accounts.
  • Responsible for maintenance of account process, procedures and playbooks working closely with Director to maintain and update as needed, ensuring consistency and compliance with overarching departmental requirements

What you bring:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in the commercial real estate lease administration industry and/or accounting and property management fields having worked in either (or both) the Landlord or Tenant sector.
  • Associate or bachelor’s degree in business, accounting, real estate, or similar field preferred.
  • Working experience with commercial real estate database applications such as Visual Lease, APEX, ProLease, CoStar, WorkTrac, Lucernex, Planon, Manhattan, or other portfolio management database systems.
  • Expertise and documented success working on multi-line global accounts with 1,000+ leases and global account management structure.
  • Intermediate proficiency level with Microsoft Office tools (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OneNote, etc.).

At Kognitiv Inc., we’re redefining what it means to be a Workday partner. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the ecosystem, we bring deep expertise, innovative thinking, and a people-first mindset to everything we do. We’re not just building better Workday solutions—we’re building a company where talented people thrive.

Ready to do your best work? Join us.

Build the "Un-buildable" on the Workday Platform.

Our Workday Extend team is small, agile, and growing at light speed. We don’t just "configure" Workday—we treat it as a development platform. We are looking for a Consultant who wants to move beyond standard modules and dive into the world of custom objects, event-driven orchestrations, and high-impact app development. This is a rare opportunity to be a founding member of a rapidly scaling Extend practice, where you will help define our development standards and build solutions that truly didn't exist before.

The Role: Architect, Developer, Trailblazer

As an Extend Consultant, you are the bridge between a client’s "I wish Workday could do this" and a fully functional, production-ready application. You will use the Workday App Builder and Orchestration Builder to create seamless experiences that live natively within the Workday UI.

Key Technical Focus Areas:

  • App Development: Build custom apps using the Workday Extend framework, managing the full lifecycle from App Hub configuration to production deployment.

  • Orchestration: Design and build complex, event-driven Workday Orchestrations to sync data across Workday and third-party systems (using the Orchestration Builder drag-and-drop tool).

  • Data Modeling: Create and manage Custom Business Objects (CBOs) and custom processes to extend the Workday data model.

  • UI/UX Design: Craft intuitive user experiences using Page Builder, ensuring a "Workday-native" look and feel for every custom task.

  • Advanced Logic: Utilize Workday Query Language (WQL) and REST/SOAP APIs to pull, push, and transform data with precision.

What You’ll Do Day-to-Day

  • Design & Prototype: Translate complex business requirements into technical blueprints including UI flows, security domains, and data models.

  • Full-Stack Extend Delivery: Independently build, test, and deploy applications, ensuring they are "update-safe" and maintainable.

  • Troubleshoot & Optimize: Debug complex logic within orchestrations and perform root-cause analysis on app performance or security issues.

  • Practice Building: Contribute to our internal Reusable Solution Library. Since our team is small, your templates and "best practices" will become the foundation for all future hires.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Functional and Integration teams to ensure Extend apps integrate perfectly with core HCM, Finance, or Student modules.

Qualifications

  • The Foundation: 3+ years of experience in Workday Extend.

  • The Toolkit: Proficient in REST APIs, JSON, and Workday Web Services. Familiarity with WQL is a major advantage.

  • The Architect Mindset: Ability to design Workday Orchestrations and custom security models independently.

  • The Builder Spirit: Experience with App Builder (Visual and Code modes) and a solid understanding of how to extend Workday's metadata-driven architecture.

  • Growth Ready: Comfortable in a "startup-style" environment within a larger company—you are proactive, love to learn, and aren't afraid to help build the roadmap as we go.

  • Communication: Ability to explain the "Art of the Possible" with Extend to non-technical stakeholders.


Kognitiv is an Equal Opportunity Employer

All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. Kognitiv will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in a manner consistent with the requirements of the law, including any applicable fair chance law.

Join Us as a Research Associate

At Health Advocate, we’re on a mission to simplify healthcare by delivering accurate, timely, and actionable information that helps people make confident decisions. As a Research Associate, you’ll play a critical role behind the scenes—connecting members, nurses, and advocates with the healthcare resources they need most. If you’re detail-oriented, curious, and motivated by meaningful work, this role offers the opportunity to make a real impact every day.

What You’ll Do: Your Roadmap to Impact

As a Research Associate, you’ll support healthcare navigation through high-quality research, organization, and follow-through. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Researching and understanding healthcare system websites, databases, and reference materials in accordance with departmental and corporate policies
  • Researching and documenting requested information such as primary care physicians, dentists, specialists, eldercare services, nursing homes, and related resources
  • Identifying appropriate benefit plans and benefit offerings when applicable
  • Providing accurate, easy-to-understand research findings to nurses, advocates, and internal partners
  • Responding to member requests by delivering clear, specific resources and available options
  • Entering and maintaining accurate documentation within internal systems
  • Compiling research results in a user-friendly format to support member decision-making
  • Tracking cases and conducting timely follow-ups with members and providers
  • Ensuring all work complies with quality standards, internal procedures, and applicable federal and state regulations, including HIPAA and COBRA
  • Monitoring recurring research issues or trends and escalating concerns to leadership as appropriate

Who You Are: The Advocate We’re Looking For

You’re someone who enjoys digging into details, organizing information, and helping others through accuracy and follow-through. You bring:

  • A high school diploma or GED required; associate degree in business, liberal arts, healthcare management, or a related field preferred
  • At least one year of healthcare-related experience preferred
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including professional phone etiquette
  • Excellent listening skills and the ability to understand and clarify requests
  • Strong problem-solving and issue-resolution abilities
  • Exceptional customer service skills and a commitment to quality
  • Solid organizational and multitasking skills, including consistent follow-up
  • Comfort using MS Word, Excel, and web-based research tools
  • The ability to work effectively in a collaborative, team-based environment
  • Bilingual skills (English/Spanish or other languages) may be required based on assignment

Why Health Advocate?

At Health Advocate, we don’t just support our members—we support our employees too. When you join our team, you’ll gain:

  • Comprehensive training and the tools you need to succeed
  • Opportunities for career growth and internal advancement
  • Competitive pay: Starting at $16 per hour
  • Benefits: A robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, tuition assistance, PTO, and paid holidays
  • A mission-driven culture focused on accuracy, compassion, and meaningful impact
  • A collaborative environment where your contributions truly matter

Your Next Move

If you’re ready to turn your research skills into a career that makes a difference, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and take the next step toward joining a team dedicated to simplifying healthcare—one well-researched solution at a time.

Company Overview

Health Advocate is the nation’s leading provider of health advocacy, navigation, well-being and integrated benefits programs. For 20 years, Health Advocate has provided expert support to help our members navigate the complexities of healthcare and achieve the best possible health and well-being. Our solutions leverage a unique combination of best-in-class, personalized support with powerful predictive data analytics and a proprietary technology platform to address nearly every clinical, administrative, wellness or behavioral health need. Whether facing common issues or an unprecedented challenge like COVID-19, our team of highly trained, compassionate experts work together to go above and beyond expectations, making healthcare easier for our members and ensuring they get the care they need.

Job Description:

The Specialist, Forms Administration supports accurate, timely, and consistent maintenance and production of operational forms, letters, notices, and other outgoing communications. This position coordinates routine updates to forms, manages revision requests, reviews materials for accuracy and completeness, and oversees the preparation and production of outgoing print materials. Working closely with internal teams and external print vendors, and under the direction of the Manager, this role ensures timelines and campaign deliverables are met and distributed on schedule.


Responsibilities:

    • Provides hands-on support and/or coordination for all new forms, including new business applications and application packages, routine form revisions, including requested changes to wording, fields, layouts, contact information, and other content

    • Manages a centralized forms repository ensuring the most current form is maintained and accessible

    • Tracks, investigates and follows up on all print and mail issues, assists with issue management and works to resolve concerns in a timely manner
    • Obtains print/mailing estimates and aligns expenses to department budgets
    • Performs maintenance of fulfillment materials
    • Manages inventory levels and replenishment orders with fulfillment vendor(s) including business card and stationary requests
    • Ensures best practices and documented procedures are followed
    • Performs various other related duties, assignments and special projects as assigned

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in a forms and fulfillment environment
    • Experience working in a regulated financial services environment
    • Experience leading process improvement and change management initiatives

About TTM

TTM Technologies, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency (“RF”) components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced printed circuit boards (“PCB”s). TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market.

Additional information can be found at www.ttm.com

TTM Technologies is seeking a detail-oriented and creative Marketing Specialist to support the company’s Aerospace & Defense sector's growing marketing function. This role sits at the intersection of event execution and executive communications and encompasses foundational marketing operations. This role supports a business that is actively expanding its brand presence across the U.S. defense community and international aerospace markets.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable managing the detailed logistics of a major industry event and crafting a polished executive presentation — someone who takes pride in the details and understands that in aerospace and defense marketing, everything we produce reflects the trust our customers place in us.

What You'll Do

Event Planning & Execution

  • Coordinate end-to-end planning and on-location support of TTM's participation in industry trade shows, conferences, hosted events, and customer-facing facility events
  • Manage logistics including display/booth/chalet coordination, vendor relationships, shipping, on-site staffing, collateral preparation, and post-event follow-up
  • Develop and maintain event timelines, budgets, and deliverables trackers
  • Liaise with external venues, show organizers, and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless execution
  • Support internal TTM conferences, including invitation management, run-of-show coordination, and on-site support
  • Track and report on event outcomes, attendance, and ROI – driving metrics reporting

Executive Presentation Development

  • Work directly with senior A&D executives to understand their communication objectives and refine messaging and presentation materials accordingly
  • Maintain a library of approved slides, templates, and brand-compliant assets for rapid deployment
  • Ensure all presentations reflect TTM's brand standards, tone, and visual identity

Marketing Operations

  • Manage TTM merchandise store; coordinate internal orders, manage inventory and proactively orchestrate the introduction of new items
  • Manage TTM A&D asset systems via Staples portal, facilitating internal orders for branded TTM assets
  • Launch and coordinate a robust TTM collateral management tool to store and share key brand material, including but not limited to images, brochures, briefings, and one-pagers

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field
  • 2–4 years of experience in a marketing, events, or communications role — preferably in a B2B or defense/aerospace environment
  • Demonstrated experience planning and executing professional events or trade show participation
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint — ability to build presentations from scratch to a high standard
  • Excellent written communication skills — clear, concise, and professional
  • Highly organized with strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Collaborative team player with the ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders

Preferred

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, or a highly regulated industry
  • Experience supporting C-suite or executive-level communications
  • Familiarity with CRM or marketing automation platforms

#ADBU

Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, 401K, Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, accident benefits, life insurance, disability benefits, paid vacation & holidays. Benefits are available 1st of the month following date of hire.

Compensation for roles at TTM Technologies varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set and level of experience. As required by local law, TTM provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in New York, California and Colorado. raw.excerpt: Job SummaryThe Senior Manager, Marketing Technology Enablement serves as the technical architecture authority for marketing automation and CDW's marketing technology ecosystem.
raw.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Manager, Marketing Technology Enablement serves as the technical architecture authority for marketing automation and CDW's marketing technology ecosystem. The role owns platform intake, triage, and the ongoing health of the martech estate, and partners closely with IT, Data, and Security teams to ensure scalable system design, stable integrations, and a proactive roadmap for feature development.

The core of the role is platform and integration architecture: designing, implementing, and governing API-driven, cloud-native integrations across CDP, CRM, journey orchestration, analytics, and activation platforms, and leading the marketing technology team that builds and supports them.

AI is an important but supporting part of this role. As generative, predictive, and agentic capabilities expand across campaign planning, audience intelligence, content operations, personalization, and measurement, this leader ensures the data foundations, integration patterns, and guardrails are in place to use them safely, moving ideas from use case to production to measurable business impact.

What You Will Do

Strategic Technical Architecture & System Design

  • Define the end-to-end architecture for marketing automation, data, and AI, ensuring reliable, scalable, and secure platforms and integrations.
    • Translate business needs into technical specifications, reference architectures, and solution designs.
    • Own intake, triage, prioritization, and resolution for platform requests, incidents, enhancements, defects, and AI use cases.
    • Partner with IT and Data teams on data models, APIs, middleware, identity resolution, and infrastructure.
    • Design and govern RESTful and event-driven APIs, including authentication, versioning, rate limits, error handling, and troubleshooting.
    • Evaluate martech and AI platforms for integration maturity, transparency, data residency, and adoption complexity.

Cloud, Data & Integration Architecture

  • Architect cloud-native integration solutions across AWS, Azure, or equivalent platforms.
    • Design scalable batch, streaming, and real-time ingestion pipelines.
    • Set monitoring, logging, observability, and alerting standards across integrations, automations, and AI services.
    • Ensure secure, governed handling of PII, consent, and model-related data across all data flows.
    • Own the identity and audience data model across CRM, CDP, and activation platforms.
    • Assess technical debt, recommend re-architecture, and manage cloud, integration, and model consumption costs.

Operational Excellence & Governance

  • Maintain platform health, performance, and governance across Marketo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce CRM, AEP/RTCDP, Monday.com, and analytics tools.
    • Ensure documentation, configurations, integrations, automations, and releases follow consistent governance and version control.
    • Monitor usage, security, and stability; escalate risks proactively and maintain rollback plans for unexpected automation or AI behavior.
    • Maintain system diagrams, data lineage, and API documentation as living artifacts.
    • Operate AI governance across approved use, data classification, disclosure, bias review, audit trails, and automated decisioning.
    • Oversee vendor technical deliverables for architecture, security, AI feature roadmaps, and model change notifications.

Enablement & Technical Leadership

  • Own the feature lifecycle from requirements through prioritization, solutioning, QA, rollout, and change management.
    • Maintain a roadmap aligned to marketing strategy, business needs, enterprise technology direction, and AI data readiness.
    • Translate technical architecture into clear documentation and executive-ready summaries.
    • Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing marketing technology team.
    • Grow team AI fluency, from prompt design and evaluation to production model API workflows.
    • Set priorities, capacity plans, and resource allocation.
    • Drive adoption by translating complex martech and AI capabilities into clear guidance for cross-functional partners.

Project, Capacity & Investment Management

  • Manage technical capacity, resource allocation, and integration demand.
    • Oversee martech and AI implementations from business case through benefit realization.
    • Prioritize roadmap investments based on scalability, risk, cost, and expected return.
    • Own platform, integration, licensing, and model usage budgets.
    • Build business cases that quantify efficiency, quality, and revenue impact.

Thought Leadership & Continuous Modernization

  • Champion composable architecture, API-first design, and reusable services.
    • Stay current on API standards, cloud models, and the AI platform landscape.
    • Lead AI and machine-learning pilots with clear success criteria and a path to production.
    • Represent marketing technology with vendors, partners, and industry peers.

AI Enablement & Decisioning

  • Partner with Marketing, Data, and IT to define where AI supports campaign planning, personalization, decisioning, and analytics.
    • Maintain a prioritized AI use case backlog across segmentation, scoring, content, conversational experiences, next-best-action, and data hygiene.
    • Design AI-assisted workflows with human review points and governed knowledge sources.
    • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Brand, and Security on acceptable use, consent, disclosure, and review requirements.
    • Support workflow standards, documentation, and training that build practical AI fluency.

What We Expect of You

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with 7+ years of experience in marketing technology, CRM integration, or enterprise integration engineering, or 11+ years of equivalent experience in lieu of a degree.
    • 3+ years designing and implementing RESTful APIs, including authentication, versioning, and governance standards.
    • Strong understanding of HTTP protocols, JSON payload design, and event-driven architecture.
    • Experience writing technical integration specifications.
    • Working knowledge of Python, JavaScript/Node.js, or similar languages.
    • Experience architecting cloud-native integrations using AWS or Azure.
    • Familiarity with event streaming platforms such as ON24 and Cvent.
    • Deep understanding of data modeling, identity resolution, and CDP architecture.
    • Platform expertise across Adobe (AEP, Marketo, RTCDP, Target) and Salesforce.
    • Proven leadership experience managing technical teams.
    • Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to make architectural and AI trade-offs legible to business leaders.

• Willingness to travel up to 10%.

  • Experience with agentic workflow platforms, multi-agent orchestration, or marketing copilots running in production, is a plus.
    • Familiarity with enterprise AI platform services such as Azure AI or AWS Bedrock and with major model providers, is a plus.
    • Experience with Adobe Experience Platform, Salesforce CRM and Marketing Cloud, or comparable real-time orchestration tooling, is a plus.
    • Experience modernizing the content supply chain, including DAM and content operations workflows, is a plus.
    • Experience in an enterprise B2B or regulated environment with formal change control, is a plus.
    • Vendor certifications in Adobe, Salesforce, or a major cloud platform, is a plus.
    • Hands-on experience applying generative or predictive AI in a marketing or customer engagement context, including prompt design, retrieval grounding, and output evaluation, is a plus.
    • Familiarity with AI governance practices such as data classification, consent, disclosure, human-in-the-loop design, and bias review, is a plus.

Pay range: $143,000 - $214,000 depending on experience and skill set

Annual bonus target of 15% subject to terms and conditions of plan

Benefits overview:

Salary ranges may be subject to geographic differentials

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization

As a leader, you will champion and be accountable for our vision of becoming an AI-fluent organization. We expect leaders to model curiosity, encourage responsible AI adoption, and foster a culture of continuous learning. You don’t need deep technical expertise, but you should be comfortable exploring how AI can enhance strategy, decision-making, and team performance. Your role includes guiding others in building confidence and capability with AI tools and practices, while promoting openness to experimentation and shared learning.

Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

About Us

CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.

As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.

Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do. Together, we Make Amazing Happen.

Job Title:

Sr. Analyst, Content Strategist

Job Description

We are looking for a passioned Content Specialist to join our fast-growing Gen AI-enabled content delivery team in the Philippines. The ideal candidate is curious about Gen AI and able to learn and understand quickly how technology can help our clients optimize their content for Gen AI-powered futures. Working under the direction of a Senior Gen AI Content Specialist you will be part of a team of Content Specialists executing best-in-class content transformation on large libraries of knowledge base content. You will decide where and how content will be segmented and refactored for optimal use by Gen AI tools. You like meticulous, detailed work, but also see and share opportunities for improvement.

As a Gen AI Content Specialist you are part editors, part technicians. You have strong reading comprehension skills and are responsible for deciding where and how large multi-page articles need to be segmented for LLM efficiency and carried context. Don’t worry, we’ll coach you at first but do expect you to lead the decision making shortly thereafter. If you love content and want a role that keeps you on the leading edge of Gen AI applications, consider joining fast growing team.

Responsibilities:

  • Execute content transformation and continuous improvements on large content libraries.

  • Innovate and optimize content processes; decide where and how content will be segmented and refactored for Gen AI tools.

  • Act as part editor and part content strategist with strong reading comprehension skills.

  • Act as both a do-er and innovator, making decisions and recommendations independently.

  • Segment large multi-page articles for LLM efficiency and context delivery.

  • Create, manage and optimize high-quality, Gen AI-optimized content for large knowledge base.

  • Be at the forefront of Gen AI applications in content; identify new opportunities for leveraging AI in content strategy.

  • Stay updated with the latest in Gen AI technology and trends.

Required skills:

  • Foundational knowledge of Gen AI uses and applications to drive better, faster ways to work. You don’t have to be an expert in the techbut need to understand what it can do for clients.

  • Gen AI curiosity and enthusiasm and wish to learn more in this space.

  • Expert English reading comprehension and editing skills. You need to be able to suggest where to break large articles and make any edits needed; we call it ‘chunking’ the articles.

  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines and projects at once.

  • Good familiarity with Word, Excel and large spreadsheets; strong Office 365 skills.

  • Natural desire to bring order and classification to content chaos. Familiarity with information architecture is a bonus.

  • Like finding patterns and problem-solving.

  • 2-3+ yearsDigital Marketing or Content Marketing experience at a large enterprise or agency.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in Marketing, Communications or a related field.

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

Job Title:

Sr. Product Manager

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.

In our Information Technology and Global Security team, you will deliver the latest technology infrastructure, transformative software solutions and industry-leading global security for our staff and clients. You will work with the best in the world to design, implement and strategize IT, security, application development, innovation, and solutions in today’s hyperconnected world. You will be part of the technology team that is core to our vision of develop, build and run the future of Integrated Services.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

About the Role

Concentrix is seeking a Product Manager to drive the strategy, execution, and commercial growth of Memory — our agentic intelligence engine that powers smarter, more personalized customer experiences across the iX Suite.

Memory is a foundational capability within the iX platform, enabling real-time customer understanding through living Memory Cards, dynamic identity resolution, and predictive intent modeling. It serves as the intelligence layer that makes every interaction across iX Hello and iX Hero smarter, faster, and more profitable.

You will operate as a recognized product expert, accountable for translating commercial targets into a focused roadmap and ensuring every feature and improvement delivered moves the needle on adoption, retention, and revenue. You will work across Engineering, Design, Sales, and Customer Success to solve complex product problems and guide the team toward measurable outcomes.

What You'll Own

Product Vision & Roadmap Execution

  • Drive the product roadmap for Memory, translating strategic direction into a prioritized, outcome-focused plan
  • Define how identity resolution, Memory Cards, intent modeling, and action delivery function as a cohesive capability; not a point solution
  • Identify and develop new product concepts where limited precedent exists

Commercial Contribution & Business Alignment

  • Contribute to revenue target setting and ensure the roadmap and delivered features are aligned to commercial goals
  • Partner with Sales, Finance, and Product Marketing to inform pricing, packaging, and monetization discussions
  • Make focused trade-off decisions across scope, cost, and timing to maximize product value

Trust, Compliance & Enterprise Readiness

  • Ensure iX Wisdom Memory meets enterprise-grade requirements
  • Balance speed of innovation with responsible AI and risk management
  • Ensure strong alignment with integrated products (e.g., iX Hello, iX Hero, Translate)

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence

  • Collaborate and influence across Engineering, Architecture, Legal, Security, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success
  • Serve as a recognized subject matter expert for Memory and agentic intelligence within the organization and with clients

Team Development

  • Guide and develop junior product team members, sharing expertise and raising the quality of product thinking
  • Coordinate activities across team members on complex projects and new assignments

What We're Looking For

Experience & Background

  • Typically requires:
  • Bachelor's degree with 8–12 years of related experience, or
  • Master's degree with 6+ years
  • Proven experience delivering complex, enterprise-grade SaaS or AI products with commercial awareness
  • Demonstrated success driving roadmap execution and cross-functional delivery in ambiguous environments

Product & Domain Expertise

  • Advanced understanding of AI-powered systems, ideally including agentic AI, ML pipelines, real-time data processing, or customer data platforms
  • Comfortable developing solutions to complex problems with limited precedent
  • Familiarity with enterprise data infrastructure (streaming pipelines, event-driven architectures, multi-tenant platforms) is a plus

Leadership & Influence

  • Strong influencing and persuasion skills — able to align diverse stakeholders and adapt messaging to different audiences
  • Clear, concise communicator who can convey complex product and technical topics to business stakeholders
  • Recognized as an expert and trusted advisor on complex matters within and beyond the immediate team

Why This Role Matters

  • Commercial Impact: You directly contribute to revenue targets and ensure the product delivers against business goals
  • Platform Leverage: Memory is the intelligence engine powering the entire iX Suite. Every Hello and Hero interaction depends on it
  • AI at Scale: Your decisions shape how Concentrix delivers agentic, predictive intelligence across global CX operations
  • Growth Opportunity: This role positions you at the center of Concentrix's most strategically differentiated AI capability

Ideal Candidate Profile

You are a product leader who:

  • Thinks in outcomes, not features
  • Brings deep expertise and uses it to guide and elevate those around you
  • Balances customer value, business performance, and technical reality
  • Thrives in complexity, adapts quickly, and delivers with clarity and accountability
